papers.title: Nonlinear Climate Resilience in Marine Capture Fisheries: Evidence From China and Norway
papers.authors: Sohail, Hafiz M.; Zhang, Dengjun; Nazir, Muhammad Shahzad; Yang, Zhengyong
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Marine capture fisheries production (MCFP) is vulnerable to climate change, but the nonlinear relationship between climate and MCFP is not yet well understood across different national fisheries systems. Using annual data from China and Norway from 1961 to 2023, random forest (RF) models and partial‐dependence plots are applied. Detrended production anomalies assess impact, recovery, and temporal variability. CO2 and surface air temperature (SAT) were the two leading predictors in both countries; in China, their ranks swapped across random seeds, while in Norway SAT consistently ranked first. At species level, CO2 and SAT were the leading predictors across the selected Chinese species and SAT across the selected Norwegian species, although relationship directions differed. China's upper–lower contrasts for CO2 and SAT are statistically supported in the primary analysis but approach zero following production‐regime adjustment. Norway's upper–lower contrast confidence intervals include zero, and the estimated change points are imprecise in both countries. China has a positive mean event‐year production shortfall, but its difference from other years is statistically uncertain. Recovery estimates depend on event definitions and regime adjustment. Norway's event estimates are generally uncertain, and its temporal‐variability point estimate is higher in the main analysis, but the cross‐country difference is statistically uncertain. Several findings are sensitive to detrending, fishing effort, and regime treatment. The results describe predictive associations rather than causal climate effects and support monitoring environmental conditions together with fishing pressure, catch composition, and long‐term MCFP changes.
papers.summary_cn: 研究利用1961—2023年中国和挪威的年度数据，采用随机森林模型与偏依赖图，结合去趋势产量异常，分析气候因子对海洋捕捞渔业产量（MCFP）的非线性影响及恢复力。CO2和地表气温（SAT）在两国均为首要预测因子，但排序与作用方向存在差异；物种层面亦以CO2和SAT为主导。中国事件年产量缺口均值为正但统计不确定性大，挪威事件估计普遍不确定，若干结论对去趋势方式、捕捞努力量和生产体制处理敏感。结果反映预测性关联而非因果效应，支持将环境监测与捕捞压力、渔获组成及长期MCFP变化结合考量。

papers.title: Metabolism, Metabolic Regulation and Nutritional Requirement of Iron in Aquaculture Species: A Critical Review
papers.authors: Wei, Xiaolei; Pantopoulos, Kostas; Hogstrand, Christer; Xu, Pengcheng; Luo, Zhi
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Iron is an essential cofactor for oxygen transport, electron transfer, DNA synthesis, and Fe‐S cluster enzymes, with its redox cycling between Fe 2+ and Fe 3+ , underpinning both its biochemical utility and cytotoxic potential via ROS generation, requiring tight homeostatic regulation across all organisms. In contrast to terrestrial vertebrates, aquatic organisms acquire iron not only from dietary sources but also directly from the surrounding water through the gills. This dual acquisition pathway has driven unique regulatory adaptations of iron homeostasis, maintained through tightly coordinated mechanisms of absorption, transport, and storage. Disruption of these mechanisms, either by deficiency or overload, can impair growth, cause anemia, promote oxidative stress, and aggravate metabolic disorders. This review synthesizes current knowledge of iron uptake routes, systemic regulation, storage, and recycling in major aquaculture species. In addition, it provides an overview of dietary iron requirements, iron deficiency and overload, and the effects of feed composition, mineral sources, functional additives and environmental factors on iron bioavailability. Finally, the review discusses ferroptosis, an iron‐dependent form of programmed cell death associated with lipid peroxidation, and highlights critical knowledge gaps and research priorities for improving iron nutrition and metabolic health in aquaculture species.
papers.summary_cn: 本文系统综述了水产养殖物种铁代谢、调控及营养需求的研究进展。与陆生脊椎动物不同，水生动物可通过鳃从水体直接摄铁，这一双重获取途径驱动了铁稳态的独特调控适应。铁缺乏或过载均可损害生长、引发贫血、加剧氧化应激和代谢紊乱；饲料组成、矿物质来源、功能性添加剂及环境因素均影响铁的生物利用度。文章还探讨了铁依赖性脂质过氧化细胞死亡（ferroptosis）及其在水产动物铁营养与代谢健康中的研究空白。

papers.title: Impact of deep-freezing on the nutrient profile of fish and seafood mostly consumed in Italy
papers.authors: Muzzioli, Luca; Di Vincenzo, Olivia; Maddaloni, Lucia; Pintavalle, Maria; Brasili, Elisa; Migliaccio, Silvia
papers.journal: Mediterranean Journal of Nutrition and Metabolism
papers.abstract: Background Deep-freezing (≤−18°C) is widely used to preserve fish and seafood and extend shelf-life limiting losses in nutritional quality. However, freezing conditions may influence ice crystal formation and cellular damage, affecting nutrient retention. Objectives To assess the impact of deep-freezing on the nutrient profile of the most commonly consumed fish and seafood in the Italian population, including Cod, Hake, Gilthead Seabream, Plaice, Salmon, Seabass, Octopus and Shrimp. Methods Studies evaluating changes in proteins, amino acids, lipids, fatty acids, vitamins, and minerals during deep-frozen storage, as well as differences in fresh vs deep-frozen fish were evaluated. Results Thirteen studies were included. Total protein content was largely preserved, although reductions in protein solubility and myofibrillar functionality were reported at higher temperatures or after prolonged storage. Total lipid content was generally stable, while fatty acid composition showed variable changes, with occasional decreases in polyunsaturated fatty acids over time. Vitamin retention was more heterogeneous, with water-soluble vitamins appearing more susceptible to degradation, than fat-soluble ones. No changes in mineral content were assessed. Conclusions Despite methodological heterogeneity, the evidence suggests that rapid deep-freezing and lower storage temperatures better preserve nutritional quality. Further standardized studies are needed to improve comparability across species and storage conditions.
papers.summary_cn: 该研究评估深冻（≤−18°C）对意大利常见消费鱼类及海产品（鳕鱼、无须鳕、金头鲷、鲽鱼、鲑鱼、海鲈、章鱼、虾）营养品质的影响，纳入13项研究进行综述。总蛋白含量基本保持稳定，但高温或长期冻藏下蛋白溶解性和肌原纤维功能下降；总脂质一般稳定，多不饱和脂肪酸随时间偶有降低；水溶性维生素较脂溶性维生素更易降解。总体证据表明快速深冻和较低冻藏温度更有利于保持营养品质，但研究方法异质性较大，尚需标准化研究以提高种间和贮藏条件间的可比性。

papers.title: The potential of the social economy and taxation to address challenges facing the maritime and fisheries sector in the Basque Country
papers.authors: Aranburu, Edriga
papers.journal: Boletín de la Asociación Internacional de Derecho Cooperativo
papers.abstract: This article analyses the roles of the social economy and taxation as drivers of a just ecological transition in the maritime and fisheries sector in the Basque Country. The paper examines the current state of the sector and its regulatory framework, from international guidelines to the powers granted by special legal provisions (norma/decreto foral) under the Basque Economic Agreement, paying particular attention to the social dimension. Finally, it identifies challenges and opportunities for fully integrating the social economy into the economic, social and environmental development of the territory, thus contributing to a sustainable ecological transition. papers.summary_cn: 该研究分析社会 economy 与税收作为巴斯克地区海洋与渔业部门公正生态转型驱动力的作用，梳理了从国际准则到巴斯克经济协定下特别法律规定所赋予权力的部门现状与监管框架，重点关注社会维度。研究识别了将社会 economy 全面融入该地区经济、社会与环境发展的挑战与机遇，以助力可持续生态转型。

papers.title: Enhancing equity and resilience in coastal small-scale fisheries: a Confucian ethical perspective on community co-management
papers.authors: Lu, Jiayan
papers.abstract: When trying to balance ecological protection with basic community livelihoods, coastal small-scale capture fisheries are facing serious governance challenges related to fairness, food security, and community resilience. Existing studies have focused on protecting rights, community participation, and the use of adaptive learning. However, further clarification is needed of how prioritizing basic needs, allocating responsibilities in light of participants’ differing circumstances, and reflecting on action can be ethically justified within a coherent framework. It is also necessary to show how these reasons can help participants understand and carry out their responsibilities. To address this ocean governance issue, this paper combines classical textual interpretation, conceptual analysis, and normative reasoning. It provides a modern explanation of “forming one body with all things,” “frugality,” and “self-cultivation through practice (shishang molian).” Through this, it builds a normative framework of relations, virtue, and practice to supplement the existing ethical arguments on co-management. The framework starts from concern for other people and marine ecosystems. It explains the ethical basis for limiting resource use, sharing conservation responsibilities, and reflecting on one’s own judgment. On this basis, it calls for respecting people’s right to participate, giving priority to basic needs within ecological limits, sharing responsibilities according to capacities, benefits, and the impacts of participants’ actions, and reviewing arrangements through joint learning. Based on this, the paper proposes four conditional propositions. These propositions concern the relationships between meaningful influence on decisions and perceived procedural fairness and governance trust; needs-based allocation and household food access; endorsement of restraint norms and compliance with fishing restrictions; and learning and feedback mechanisms and community resilience. Finally, the paper also suggests ways to test these propositions in future research. This paper links the ethical evaluation of co-management arrangements with how actors understand and carry out their responsibilities, providing an interconnected ethical basis for coastal fisheries governance. At the same time, the propositions still need empirical testing, and the choice of specific institutional arrangements and their application in different cultural contexts require further justification.
papers.summary_cn: 本文针对沿海小规模捕捞渔业在生态保护与社区生计之间的治理难题，融合经典文本解读、概念分析与规范推理，对“万物一体”“节俭”“事上磨练”进行现代阐释，构建关系、德性与实践的规范框架以补充co-management的伦理论证。框架主张尊重参与权、在生态限度内优先满足基本需求、按能力与受益及行为影响分担责任，并通过共同学习审视制度安排。据此提出四组条件性命题，涉及决策影响力与程序公平感知及治理信任、基于需求的分配与家庭食物获取、克制规范认同与捕捞限制遵从、学习反馈机制与社区韧性之间的关系，供未来实证检验。

papers.title: Soybean meal-induced enteritis in fish: a microbiota-immune-metabolic perspective informed by bibliometric analysis and multi-database validation
papers.authors: Liu, Hao; Zhu, Ruizhi; Liu, Yingyue; Wen, Yuhuan; Zhang, Li; Liu, Zhikui; Zhao, Jian; Liu, Hongsheng; Feng, Huawei
papers.abstract: Introduction Fish enteritis is a major health challenge in aquaculture as low-fishmeal feeding strategies become more common. Soybean meal-induced enteritis (SBMIE) is a representative model of diet-induced intestinal inflammation, but evidence remains dispersed across species, feed ingredients, pathological endpoints, and mechanistic approaches. Methods We mapped fish enteritis research using 554 Web of Science Core Collection publications from 2010 to 2024 and analyzed publication trends, contributors, keyword evolution, and co-citation patterns with CiteSpace and VOSviewer. Scopus and PubMed were used for cross-database validation, yielding 475 eligible publications after screening and deduplication. Mechanistic evidence from the 2010–2024 corpus was narratively synthesized and updated with eligible SBMIE studies published through 30 June 2026. Results Research output increased markedly after 2018, with China, Norway, and the United States as major contributors and Aquaculture and Fish &amp; Shellfish Immunology as leading journals. Keyword and co-citation analyses identified soybean meal, Atlantic salmon, distal intestine, gut microbiota, immune response, and lipid metabolism as central or emerging themes. Annual publication counts showed a strong positive correlation between the WOSCC and Scopus/PubMed datasets (Pearson’s r = 0.922, p &lt; 0.001). Mechanistically, SBMIE can be organized into a layered framework involving soybean-derived triggers and epithelial barrier disruption, microbiota dysbiosis with innate immune amplification, and intestinal metabolic remodeling with possible gut-liver involvement. Barrier dysfunction and TLR/MAPK/NF-κB-related inflammatory activation are relatively well supported, whereas the causal roles of microbiota shifts, microbial metabolites, bile acids, short-chain fatty acids (SCFAs), tryptophan-AhR signaling, and AMPK/FOXO-related responses require further validation. Conclusion This review maps the fish-enteritis research landscape and synthesizes mechanistic evidence on SBMIE. The narrative synthesis provides a microbiota–immune–metabolic perspective on SBMIE, although causal links among these processes require further validation. Future work should use component-specific SBMIE models, time-course designs, causal microbiota–metabolite validation, and production-relevant feeding trials to support mechanism-guided soybean inclusion strategies in aquafeeds.
papers.summary_cn: 该研究通过文献计量学（554篇WOSCC文献，2010–2024）结合Scopus/PubMed跨库验证（475篇），系统梳理鱼类肠炎研究格局，并整合机制证据构建豆粕诱导肠炎（SBMIE）的微生物–免疫–代谢分层框架。研究发现2018年后发文量显著增长，中国、挪威、美国为主要贡献者，豆粕、大西洋鲑、后肠、肠道菌群、免疫应答和脂质代谢为核心主题；屏障功能障碍及TLR/MAPK/NF-κB炎症激活证据较充分，而菌群变化、微生物代谢物、胆汁酸、SCFAs、色氨酸-AhR及AMPK/FOXO的因果作用尚待验证。作者建议未来采用组分特异性SBMIE模型、时间序列设计及因果性菌群–代谢物验证，以支撑水产饲料中豆粕的机制导向型添加策略。

papers.title: Bioinspired trajectory tracking control of an underactuated robotic fish using prescribed-time and prescribed-performance control
papers.authors: Wang, Xinqi; Wang, Ming; Liu, Xinyang; Pan, Sida; Wang, Feige; Yu, Junzhi
papers.abstract: Abstract Fish swimming couples rhythmic body deformation, distributed coordination, and environmental interaction to produce propulsion and maneuvering. This study asks how these principles can inspire trajectory regulation for an underactuated robotic fish. A three-joint body–caudal model driven by a coupled central pattern generator is combined with prescribed-performance guidance, a filtered reduced-order observer, and a bounded prescribed-time regulator. Lateral control is treated as virtual guidance and realized through coordinated heading and body–caudal motion rather than an independently actuated sway force. A practical prescribed-time boundedness result accounts for observer, model, sampling, and actuator effects. Validation combines numerical simulation, an independent physics-based UE5 environment, and outdoor lake experiments. The two available lake runs achieve position RMSEs of 0.3768 m and 0.2600 m for straight and circular trajectories, respectively. The results show that the virtual lateral-guidance channel substantially improves spatial tracking and that the bioinspired locomotion structure can be carried from modeling to physical deployment.
papers.summary_cn: 研究针对欠驱动机器鱼，将三关节体-尾模型与耦合中枢模式发生器结合，并引入预设性能制导、滤波降阶观测器及有界预设时间调节器，把横向控制作为虚拟制导，通过协调艏向与体-尾运动实现而非独立横向驱动。通过数值仿真、基于物理的UE5环境和户外湖泊实验验证，直线与圆形轨迹的位置RMSE分别为0.3768 m和0.2600 m。结果表明虚拟横向制导通道显著提升空间跟踪性能，仿生运动结构可从建模贯通至实机部署。

papers.title: Single Species and Variable Environments but Different Fish? A Case Study of the Gray Rockfish Sebastes glaucus (Sebastidae, Scorpaeniformes) in the Northern Sea of Okhotsk
papers.authors: Radchenko, Olga A.; Nazarkin, Mikhail V.; Moreva, Irina N.; Shestakov, Alexander V.; Pospekhov, Vitaly V.; Petrovskaya, Anna V.; Korostelev, Nikolai B.; Orlov, Alexei M.
papers.journal: Journal of Marine Science and Engineering
papers.abstract: The specific habitat conditions in different parts of a species’ range may give rise to intraspecific polymorphism at various levels (morphological, biological, genetic, etc.), but this phenomenon has not been sufficiently studied. Here, the results of research on the morphological, biological, genetic, karyological, and parasitological characteristics of the gray rockfish Sebastes glaucus (Sebastidae, Scorpaeniformes) in two water bodies differing in habitat conditions are presented, i.e., a desalinated lagoon and adjacent sea areas off Zavyalov Island (the northern Sea of Okhotsk). Individuals in the two water bodies were found to differ significantly in terms of some morphological characteristics (the number of lateral line pores and the total number of vertebrae), size (the fish in the lagoon are smaller in length and body weight), maximum age and growth rates (individuals in the sea reach a greater age and grow faster), chromosome morphology and the number of chromosome arms, and the degree of infection with metacercariae of trematodes (100% in the lagoon and their complete absence in the sea). Furthermore, samples from the lagoon and the sea are reliably differentiated from each other based on genetic analysis using mtDNA markers. The identified differences may be due to a combination of factors, including both abiotic (higher temperature and lower salinity in the lagoon and its isolation from the sea) and biotic (limited forage resources and high parasite load in the isolated lagoon) factors.
papers.summary_cn: 研究比较了鄂霍次克海北部淡化潟湖与Zavyalov岛邻近海域中灰平鲉（Sebastes glaucus）在形态、生物学、遗传、核型和寄生虫特征上的种内分化。结果显示两水体个体在侧线孔数、脊椎总数、体长体重、最大年龄与生长速率、染色体形态及臂数、吸虫囊蚴感染率（潟湖100%、海域完全缺失）等方面存在显著差异，mtDNA标记亦支持二者可靠区分。差异可能源于潟湖较高水温、较低盐度、隔离状态及有限饵料资源和高寄生虫负荷等非生物与生物因素的综合作用。

papers.title: Recent history improves prediction of collective rotation in beetle and fish groups
papers.authors: Li, Runlin; Yin, Mingxu; Liu, Rui; Peng, Qin
papers.abstract: Abstract Macroscopic descriptions of collective motion require observables that retain information about future dynamics. We tested the predictive value of recent rotation beyond instantaneous group structure using three whirligig-beetle recordings for model development and 12 for evaluation, with nine golden-shiner recordings assessing transfer of fixed categorical settings. In beetles, adding rotation five frames earlier to current rotation, polarization, group radius and shape reduced mean-squared error by 13.73% and 13.20% at three- and ten-frame horizons. Estimating current rotation and its trend from six observations over the same interval further improved prediction in every recording at horizons of 3, 10 and 30 frames. In stochastic simulations, history reduced direction switching from 17.124 to 5.671 switches per minute, closer to the observed rate of 2.808, and improved waiting-time curves. Residual switching and correlation errors remained in smaller groups, and stationary distributions showed no consistent improvement. Time spent in the current rotational category accounted for 59.20% of the four-observation prediction-score gain, while longer contexts retained additional information. In fish, categorical history improved prediction under both body-heading and movement-based definitions of rotation; continuous gains depended on the definition. Short observation windows therefore provide effective coordinates for reduced prediction, with clearer benefits for switching dynamics than for stationary statistics.
papers.summary_cn: 研究利用旋转甲虫和 golden-shiner 鱼群录像，检验近期旋转历史对群体集体旋转预测的价值。将5帧前的旋转信息加入当前旋转、极化、群体半径和形状等变量后，甲虫在3帧和10帧预测窗口的均方误差分别降低13.73%和13.20%；基于6次观测估计当前旋转及其趋势可进一步改善所有录像在3、10、30帧窗口的预测。随机模拟中，历史信息使方向切换率从每分钟17.124次降至5.671次，更接近观测值2.808次，并改善等待时间曲线；鱼类中分类历史在两种旋转定义下均提升预测，但连续增益依赖定义。结果表明短观测窗口可提供有效的降维预测坐标，对切换动态的改善优于对平稳统计量的改善。

papers.title: Molecular Diagnostic Yield of NGS and MLPA/FISH in Neurofibromatosis Type 1: A Regional Romanian Cohort Study
papers.authors: Jurca, Aurora Alexandra; Ghitea, Timea Claudia; Buzlea-Zaha, Cristina; Hodișan, Ramona; Andreescu, Nicoleta; Chirita-Emandi, Adela; Bănescu, Claudia; Vesa, Cosmin Mihai; Iuhas, Oana; Kozma, Kinga
papers.abstract: Background/Objectives: Neurofibromatosis type 1 (NF1) has variable clinical expression and marked allelic heterogeneity. This study assessed the diagnostic yield of molecular testing in a regional Romanian cohort with an initial clinical diagnosis of NF1 and described the clinical features of patients with NF1 molecular findings. Methods: This retrospective study included 77 patients evaluated between 1990 and 2025. We reviewed the use and results of next-generation sequencing (NGS), multiplex ligation-dependent probe amplification (MLPA), and fluorescence in situ hybridization (FISH). Results: Of the 77 patients, 42 (54.5%) underwent molecular testing. NGS was performed in 36 patients, MLPA in 15, and FISH in 7. NGS identified pathogenic or likely pathogenic NF1 sequence variants in 30 of 36 sequenced patients (83.3%), representing 30 of 42 tested patients (71.4%). In one additional patient with a negative NGS result, MLPA detected a suspected intragenic NF1 deletion that was not independently confirmed. Including this finding, the observed yield was 31/36 (86.1%) among sequenced patients and 31/42 (73.8%) among all tested patients. FISH detected no 17q11.2 microdeletions. One patient had an NF1 variant of uncertain significance. Each of the three recurrent NF1 variants was observed within a single family. A homozygous pathogenic MSH6 variant led to the reclassification of one patient as having constitutional mismatch repair deficiency (CMMRD). Conclusions: NGS identified a pathogenic or likely pathogenic NF1 variant in 30 of the 36 sequenced patients. Because access to testing and the methods used varied across the cohort, this proportion applies to the sequenced subgroup. In one child initially diagnosed with NF1, molecular testing established a diagnosis of CMMRD.

papers.title: Sanitation, Hygiene, and Supply Management Practices Among Fish Vendors in Bongao Public Market, Tawi-Tawi, Philippines
papers.authors: Alrashid, Amira B.; Abdurahim, Nasra S.; Mawal, Malkaisar A.
papers.journal: International Journal of Sustainable and Integrated Studies
papers.abstract: This study assessed sanitation and hygiene practices, supply management, and operational challenges among fish vendors at Bongao Public Market, Tawi-Tawi, Philippines. Using a descriptive cross-sectional case study design, 50 vendors were selected through quota sampling. Data were gathered through structured questionnaires, supplemented by interviews and direct observations, and analyzed using frequencies, percentages, and weighted means. All respondents were male and Tausug, while the largest age group was 31–40 years (36%). Heavy rainfall was the leading operational challenge (74%), followed by hot weather (24%). Vendors reported frequent avoidance of spoiled fish (weighted mean = 4.78), washing fish before display (4.70), and cleaning stalls and tools (4.62). However, proper waste disposal (2.44), covering displayed fish (2.18), and wearing protective gear (2.07) received low ratings. Respondents generally reported sufficient fish supplies for daily sales (4.66). Overall, established hygiene routines and perceived supply adequacy coexisted with weaknesses in contamination prevention and weather-related operational challenges. The study recommends regular food safety training, improved waste collection and drainage, accessible protective equipment, fish covers, and appropriate ice or refrigeration facilities. Findings are limited by nonprobability sampling at one market, reliance primarily on vendor reports, and the absence of microbiological testing. By identifying specific priorities for vendors and market administrators, this study provides practical evidence for locally responsive sanitation improvements. Coordinated action among local government units, public health authorities, and vendors is particularly important. Its implications support Sustainable Development Goal 3, Good Health and Well-Being, while encouraging safer seafood handling and more sustainable fish vending livelihoods in Bongao.
papers.summary_cn: 该研究评估了菲律宾Tawi-Tawi省Bongao公共市场鱼贩的卫生与清洁操作、供应链管理及经营挑战，采用描述性横断面案例设计，通过配额抽样对50名鱼贩进行问卷调查并结合访谈与直接观察。结果显示，鱼贩普遍养成避免售卖变质鱼、展示前清洗鱼体及清洁摊位工具等卫生习惯，但在废弃物规范处理、展示鱼品遮盖和防护装备穿戴方面得分较低；强降雨是首要经营挑战。研究建议开展食品安全培训、改善垃圾收集与排水设施、提供防护装备及冰鲜冷藏设施，以提升当地水产品处理安全水平。

papers.title: Consumption of exotic rainbow smelt (Osmerus mordax) is associated with altered trophic ecology and reduced condition and growth of lake trout (Salvelinus namaycush) in the Sudbury Basin
papers.authors: Therrien, Christian A.; Adeli, Kevin Assad; Wolfe, Patricia C; Matesic, Sarah; Edwards, Katie; Johnston, Thomas A.; Thorn, Michael; Neff, Bryan D.; Swanson, Heidi K
papers.abstract: There is growing concern that exotic rainbow smelt (Osmerus mordax [Mitchill, 1814]), are impacting lake trout (Salvelinus namaycush [Walbaum in Artedi, 1792]) fisheries in lakes where they have invaded beyond direct competition and predation. Smelt contain the thiamine-degrading enzyme thiaminase whose consumption can cause thiamine deficiency, which decreases growth and condition. Recent studies further suggest smelt may also impact trout indirectly by altering trophic interactions and reducing the flow of thiamine through the food web. Here, we used a multi-lake study in the Sudbury Basin (Ontario, Canada) to test whether presence of exotic smelt was associated with changes in trout trophic ecology, body condition, growth, and tissue thiamine status. Muscle thiamine concentrations in trout did not differ between lakes with and without smelt, although one fish from Wanapitei Lake (smelt lake) exhibited muscle thiamine at concentrations that can be associated with thiamine deficiency. Body condition was significantly lower in trout from lakes with smelt, and asymptotic length of trout populations declined with increasing proportion of smelt in the diet. Muscle δ15N values were significantly higher in trout from smelt-invaded lakes, and muscle thiamine concentrations declined with increasing δ15N. We discuss possible impacts of consumption of smelt on lake trout conservation.
papers.summary_cn: 为检验外来 rainbow smelt 入侵是否通过改变营养生态间接影响 lake trout，研究在加拿大 Sudbury Basin 多个湖泊比较了有无 smelt 湖泊中鳟的营养生态、体况、生长及组织硫胺素状态。结果显示肌肉硫胺素浓度在两类湖泊间无显著差异，但含 smelt 湖泊中鳟的体况显著较低，且鳟种群渐近体长随食谱中 smelt 比例升高而下降。含 smelt 湖泊鳟的肌肉 δ15N 显著更高，且硫胺素浓度随 δ15N 升高而降低，提示 smelt 消费与营养位置改变及生长、体况下降相关。

papers.title: Petroleum Hydrocarbon Residue Levels and Crude Fat Content in Finfish and Shellfish from Parangipettai and Pazhaiyar Landing Centres, Tamil Nadu, India
papers.authors: Gunamathy, K.; Kumaresan, S.; Bragadeeswaran, S.; Srikavibharathi, S.; Sasidharan, T.; Asarudeen, J. Mohamed; Abinaya, V.; Rathinam, W. V. Celcia Gnana; Sandhiya, P.
papers.abstract: Petroleum-derived residues in edible aquatic organisms provide an indication of contaminant occurrence in coastal fisheries, although aggregate fluorescence measurements cannot identify individual toxic constituents. Finfish and shellfish collected from the Parangipettai and Pazhaiyar fish landing centres at the Vellar and Coleroon estuarine mouths, Tamil Nadu, in December 2024, were examined for solvent-extractable, chrysene-calibrated petroleum hydrocarbon (PHC) fluorescence and crude fat. The collection comprised ten finfish and ten shellfish taxa, with 38 specimens recorded in each group across the two landing centres. The reported finfish PHC ranges were 0.25–1.30 µg/g wet weight at Parangipettai and 0.10–1.20 µg/g at Pazhaiyar; the corresponding shellfish ranges were 1.67–4.75 and 1.40–4.82 µg/g. The site-level summary means were 0.784 and 0.662 µg/g for finfish and 2.801 and 2.876 µg/g for shellfish, respectively. Extractable fat values spanned 0.9–9.71% in finfish and 0.5–10.9% in shellfish. Shellfish showed higher PHC concentrations in the reported group summaries, but sampling during a single month does not establish temporal trends, sources or bioaccumulation rates. Because the assay was not compound-specific, regulatory compliance and risks to seafood consumers cannot be determined from these measurements alone.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究测定了印度泰米尔纳德邦Parangipettai和Pazhaiyar两个登陆中心共20种鱼类与贝类（各38份样本）中可溶剂提取的石油烃（PHC，以䓛校准的荧光法测定）残留及粗脂肪含量。结果显示贝类PHC浓度（1.40–4.82 µg/g湿重）明显高于鱼类（0.10–1.30 µg/g），粗脂肪范围分别为0.5–10.9%和0.9–9.71%。由于采样仅限单月且荧光法无法区分具体化合物，尚不能据此判断时间趋势、污染来源、生物累积速率或消费者健康风险。

papers.title: FishMonitorAI: Methodology and Annotated Video Dataset for Fish Detection and Multi-Object Tracking in Recirculating Aquaculture System
papers.authors: Ronzhin, Andrey; Astapova, Marina; Uzdiaev, Mikhail; Le, Van; Cherskikh, Ekaterina; Volodina, Viktoria; Figurek, Aleksandra
papers.abstract: The transition to precision aquaculture systems requires the introduction of automated methods for continuous monitoring of the physiological state and behavior of aquatic organisms. The practical implementation of video analytics systems in recirculating aquaculture systems (RAS) is constrained by the non-representativeness of existing image datasets, the shortage of annotated video sequences for individual fish instance tracking tasks, and the lack of systematized engineering recommendations for organizing video recording in an artificial aquatic environment with high concentrations of suspended solids, variable lighting, and hydrodynamic interference. This study proposes methodologies for video recording and creating an annotated video dataset required for training a video analytics system for RAS. An analytical review of modern approaches to recognizing feeding behavior, fish detection and tracking, and morphometric analysis of fish was conducted. The identified limitations of existing open datasets relate to the predominance of static RGB images, the insufficient number of annotated video sequences, and limited species representation. Requirements are formulated for video recording equipment and its installation, as well as for lighting systems, auxiliary sensors, and recording schedules, with the aim of reducing the impact of common image artifacts such as low contrast, blur, glare, uneven illumination, and color distortion. To address the tasks of detecting and tracking a group of objects, a methodology for frame-by-frame annotation of video sequences using a modified TrackMe tool was developed, allowing the consistent formation of trajectories of individual fish while preserving their identity under conditions of occlusion and high stocking density in RAS. The developed FishMonitorAI Dataset corpus includes 8017 frames obtained from 12 video recordings of Lena sturgeon (Acipenser baerii) and grouped into four subsets corresponding to behavioral states (rest, feeding) and external stimuli (light stimulus, strike on the tank wall). In the current version, 900 frames of the calm-state subset (three 30-s segments) have been manually annotated with bounding boxes and individual track identifiers (16,543 boxes) following an explicitly defined visibility criterion. Baseline experiments with leave-one-sequence-out cross-validation showed that four detectors (YOLOv8n, YOLO11n, YOLO11s, RT-DETR-l) reach mAP@0.5 of 91.6–92.2% but only 44.6–47.3% mAP@0.5:0.95, while the best tracking configuration achieves HOTA = 42.6% and IDF1 = 47.0%; even with ground-truth boxes, IDF1 does not exceed 73.4%, indicating that preserving the identity of visually similar sturgeon is the main challenge of the dataset. The engineering recommendations, annotation methodology, and annotated corpus with baselines are intended to facilitate the development of fish detection and tracking models for recirculating aquaculture systems.
papers.summary_cn: 该研究针对循环水养殖系统（RAS）中鱼类检测与多目标跟踪缺乏代表性数据和工程规范的问题，提出了视频录制方法并构建了带标注的视频数据集FishMonitorAI。数据集包含12段Lena sturgeon（Acipenser baerii）视频共8017帧，覆盖休息、摄食及光照和撞击等行为状态，其中900帧经逐帧标注（16,543个边界框及个体轨迹标识）。基线实验显示四种检测器mAP@0.5达91.6–92.2%，但mAP@0.5:0.95仅44.6–47.3%，最佳跟踪配置HOTA为42.6%、IDF1为47.0%，表明外观相似鲟鱼的个体身份保持是该数据集的主要挑战。

papers.title: Projected habitat shifts of Sardina pilchardus under climate change on the Portuguese coast
papers.authors: Reis, Tatiana; Pinto, Lígia; Mateus, Marcos
papers.abstract: Sardina pilchardus (European sardine) is a small pelagic fish that primarily inhabits the northeastern Atlantic and plays a key ecological and economic role in Portuguese and Spanish fisheries. Its distribution is closely linked to temperature and ocean productivity, making it potentially vulnerable to climate change. Despite extensive research on climate-driven shifts in marine species distributions, applications of Species Distribution Models (SDMs) to Sardina pilchardus in the Iberian Peninsula remain limited. SDMs provide a spatially explicit framework for relating species occurrences to environmental conditions and projecting changes in habitat suitability under future climate scenarios. This study tests the hypothesis that future climate change will alter the spatial distribution of potential suitable habitat for Sardina pilchardus along the Atlantic Iberian coast, and evaluates whether changes in sea surface temperature, wind-driven upwelling, and other oceanographic conditions contribute to these projected changes. Boosted Regression Trees (BRT), a machine-learning SDM, were used to project shifts in habitat suitability under the SSP2-4.5 and SSP5-8.5 climate scenarios, with sea surface temperature, chlorophyll-a concentration, salinity, bathymetry, upwelling index, and mixed layer depth as predictors of sardine distribution. The projections indicate an overall expansion of potential suitable habitat, particularly along the Galician coast and in the Gulf of Cádiz, with localized losses between Lisbon and the Algarve. These projected habitat gains are primarily associated with summer mixed layer depth and summer upwelling. Under SSP2-4.5, potential suitable habitat, which reflects environmental suitability rather than realized distribution or abundance, is projected to increase by 66% for 2040–2069 and by 69% for 2070–2099 relative to 2003–2022; under SSP5-8.5, the projected increases are 63% and 77%, respectively. These results suggest that future changes in potential sardine habitat along the Atlantic Iberian coast may be driven more strongly by changes in water-column structure and upwelling than by temperature.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究利用Boosted Regression Trees (BRT) 物种分布模型，以海表温度、叶绿素a浓度、盐度、水深、上升流指数和混合层深度为预测变量，模拟SSP2-4.5和SSP5-8.5气候情景下葡萄牙大西洋沿岸欧洲沙丁鱼（Sardina pilchardus）潜在适宜栖息地的变化。结果表明，未来适宜栖息地总体扩张，尤其在Galician沿岸和Cádiz湾，而Lisbon至Algarve之间出现局部丧失；SSP2-4.5下2040–2069年和2070–2099年分别增加66%和69%，SSP5-8.5下分别增加63%和77%。栖息地增益主要与夏季混合层深度和夏季上升流相关，提示水柱结构和上升流变化对沙丁鱼栖息地的影响可能强于温度。

papers.title: Can Empirical Catch Allocation Strategies Based on Single‐Region Stock Assessments Provide Adequate Advice for Managing Spatially Structured Fish Populations?
papers.authors: Li, Chengxue; Deroba, Jonathan J.; Goethel, Daniel R.; Berger, Aaron M.; Schueller, Amy M.; Langseth, Brian J.; Liljestrand, Emily M.; Hanselman, Dana H.; Miller, Timothy J.
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Spatial structure and movement are common features of marine fish populations, yet many fisheries management systems continue to rely on single‐region stock assessments. When stock‐level catch advice is generated at a broader spatial scale than management implementation, empirical catch allocation strategies provide a way to distribute harvest among regions and fleets. However, the performance of spatial catch allocation approaches remains poorly understood in terms of their ability to achieve robust management outcomes, especially when confronted with uncertainty in underlying population structure, movement and recruitment dynamics. Using a closed‐loop management strategy evaluation (MSE) conditioned on a demersal fish population (western Atlantic black sea bass, Centropristis striata ), we compared uniform, catch‐based, survey‐based, and catch‐survey hybrid catch allocation strategies across operating model scenarios that varied in population structure, movement directionality and magnitude, and recruitment dynamics. Across scenarios, catch allocation strategy generally affected regional outcomes more strongly than system‐level outcomes, redistributing catch, biomass, interannual variability in catch and depletion risk among regions. Differences among strategies were modest under bidirectional movement and recruitment varying around regional means, but stronger regional tradeoffs emerged when movement was unidirectional or recruitment declined in one population component. Uniform and catch‐based strategies generally produced steadier catches, whereas survey‐based strategies were more responsive to changes in regional biomass distribution but increased interannual variability in catch. No single strategy consistently outperformed others across metrics or spatial scales. Empirical catch allocation can provide a useful bridge between spatially aggregated assessment advice and spatial management, but its performance is conditional on underlying spatial processes.
papers.summary_cn: 研究评估了基于单区域 stock assessment 的经验性渔获分配策略在空间结构鱼类种群管理中的表现。以黑海鲈（Centropristis striata）为对象，采用闭环管理策略评价（MSE），比较了均等分配、基于渔获、基于调查及渔获-调查混合四种分配策略在种群结构、移动方向和幅度及补充动态不同情景下的效果。结果表明，渔获分配策略对区域层面结果的影响强于系统层面，主要体现为渔获、生物量、年际变异和资源枯竭风险在区域间的再分配；双向移动且补充围绕区域均值波动时策略间差异较小，但单向移动或某一种群组分补充下降时区域间权衡加剧。均等和基于渔获的策略渔获更稳定，基于调查的策略对区域生物量变化响应更灵敏但渔获年际变异增大，无单一策略在所有指标或空间尺度上始终最优。经验性渔获分配可在空间聚合的评估建议与空间管理之间发挥桥梁作用，但其表现取决于潜在的空间过程。

papers.title: Linking benthic dynamics and herbivore assemblages across a chronically disturbed Caribbean reef
papers.authors: Randazzo-Eisemann, Ángela; Hermosillo-Núñez, Brenda B.; Ortega-Vargas, David Arturo
papers.abstract: Mass coral bleaching events increasingly interact with chronic and acute stressors to reshape tropical reef ecosystems. Caribbean reefs are particularly vulnerable to these cumulative effects, as recurrent thermal stress acts on ecosystems already transformed by disease, coral mortality, and local and regional stressors. Here, we evaluated spatial and seasonal variation in benthic communities and their associations with herbivore assemblages across eight back- and fore-reef sites in Parque Nacional Arrecife de Puerto Morelos (PNAPM), Mexican Caribbean, during the dry, rainy, and cold-front seasons of 2024. Benthic communities differed substantially among sites, with turf algae–sediment matrix and fleshy macroalgae dominating much of the reef system and hard-coral cover remaining generally low. Benthic composition varied significantly among seasons, with a reef zone × season interaction indicating contrasting seasonal trajectories between back- and fore-reef environments, despite the absence of an overall difference between reef zones. Herbivore assemblages also differed markedly among sites but showed no consistent spatial or seasonal pattern at the community level. Associations between herbivores and benthic composition were restricted to particular functional groups and benthic components, revealing selective and context-dependent herbivore–benthos relationships. Overall, decades of cumulative disturbance have not resulted in a uniform contemporary benthic state in Puerto Morelos. Instead, contrasting benthic configurations persist and reorganize seasonally, while their relationships with herbivore assemblages remain context dependent. These findings show that understanding the trajectories of chronically disturbed Caribbean reefs requires recognizing the spatial and seasonal complexity of benthic communities and the context-dependent nature of their relationships with herbivores
papers.summary_cn: 研究评估了墨西哥加勒比Puerto Morelos国家礁区8个礁后与礁前站点在2024年旱季、雨季和冷锋季的底栖群落时空变化及其与草食性鱼类群落的关联。底栖群落站点间差异显著，以turf algae–sediment matrix和肉质大型藻类为主，硬珊瑚覆盖普遍偏低，且存在礁区×季节交互作用。草食性动物群落站点间差异明显但无一致时空格局，其与底栖组成的关联仅限特定功能群和底栖组分，呈情境依赖性。结果表明长期累积扰动下该礁区底栖状态并非均一，而是持续分化并随季节重组。

papers.title: Young-of-year dispersal and within-family growth variation in steelhead/rainbow trout: implications for diversified bet-hedging
papers.authors: Ohms, Haley; Lazari, Carolina; Garza, John Carlos; Pearse, Devon E.; Boughton, David Alan
papers.abstract: Intraspecific life-history diversity can help salmonid populations cope with environmental variability, yet the mechanisms generating this diversity are poorly understood. Using genetic sibship reconstruction, we measured spatial separation among siblings as a proxy for early-life dispersal, and size differences among siblings of steelhead/rainbow trout (Oncorhynchus mykiss) sampled 4–7 months after emergence across a watershed. Sibling separation was widespread, with ~90% of families exhibiting spatial separation among sampled siblings. Mean within-family dispersal distance was 8.1 river kilometers (rkm), increasing to ~10 rkm when accounting for an increasing to asymptotic relationship with family size, and maximum dispersal reached 40 rkm. Greater sibling separation was associated with increased variation in sibling body size. Body size declined from the lower mainstem upstream and stabilized beyond ~14 rkm. Sex and Omy05 haplotype were not associated with sibling separation or within-family variation in body size. These results suggest that early-life dispersal into a heterogenous river network could be a mechanism for within-family phenotypic diversity consistent with diversified bet hedging.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究利用遗传同胞重建技术，以钢头鳟/虹鳟（Oncorhynchus mykiss）为对象，在流域尺度上量化同胞个体间的空间分离程度（作为早期扩散的代理指标）及同胞体型差异。结果显示约90%的家系存在同胞空间分离，平均家系内扩散距离为8.1 rkm（校正家系规模后约10 rkm），最大达40 rkm，且同胞分离程度越大，家系内体型变异越高。性别和Omy05单倍型与同胞分离及家系内体型变异均无关联。结果表明，早期扩散进入异质性河网可能是产生家系内表型多样性、符合多样化赌注对冲（diversified bet-hedging）策略的机制。

papers.title: Survival and swim speed performance of Alewife, a small, laterally compressed prey fish, following acoustic transmitter implantation
papers.authors: Larocque, Sarah M.; Smith, Kurtis; Hlina, Benjamin L.; Ivanova, Silviya V.; Vrooman, Laura; Johnson, Timothy B.; Fisk, Aaron T.; Brownscombe, Jacob W.
papers.abstract: Abstract Alewife ( Alosa pseudoharengus ) is a small, pelagic fish that is an important prey source for piscivores in the Laurentian Great Lakes, yet its spatial ecology is poorly known, which limits the ability to monitor populations. Acoustic telemetry is a tool to understand spatial ecology; however, there may be tagging effects on a smaller body‐sized population of Alewife where tag burden is higher than in larger‐bodied marine populations. We assessed survival, swimming abilities and healing of Alewife from Lake Ontario after acoustic transmitter implantation. In a laboratory setting, tagged Alewife were compared across tag sizes (Innovasea models V6 and V7‐4x), controls and shams (surgery conducted with no tag implantation) in fall 2024 ( n = 76). Tagging survival was also assessed in spring 2025 (variety of V7 tags) when Alewife had developed gonads and across sex ( n = 126). Capture, transport and laboratory introduction resulted in moderate mortality in fall 2024 (40%), which was reduced in spring 2025 (4%), an improvement we attribute to the refined protocols reported here. Post‐treatment (transmitter, sham, control) survival was high (100% in fall; 91% in spring) with tag burdens from 2 to 8%. We attribute lower spring survival to gonad development, but it was also influenced significantly by a holding tank effect. Two weeks post‐tagging, Alewife achieved critical swimming speeds of 37.9 ± 7.6 cm s −1 , with no significant differences among treatments. Incisions were all scored as moderately to highly healed 2 weeks post‐surgery. Our findings establish the feasibility of tagging smaller, freshwater Alewife with acoustic tags, following best practices reported here, for telemetry applications in the Great Lakes to better understand the spatial ecology of this lower trophic species of major management and ecosystem importance.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究评估了在安大略湖小型淡水灰西鲱（Alewife, *Alosa pseudoharengus*）体内植入acoustic transmitter后的存活率、游泳能力及伤口愈合情况，比较了不同tag规格（V6与V7-4x）、sham手术与对照组在2024年秋季（n=76）及2025年春季（n=126，性腺发育期）的表现。结果表明，经优化捕捞与暂养流程后，春季捕获死亡率由40%降至4%，处理组存活率高（秋季100%、春季91%），tag burden为2%–8%；tagging两周后临界游泳速度为37.9 ± 7.6 cm s⁻¹，各处理间无显著差异，切口愈合良好。研究证实，按所报道的最佳实践，对小型淡水Alewife进行acoustic tagging是可行的，可支撑Great Lakes中该低营养级关键物种空间生态学的telemetry研究。

papers.title: Assessment of Biomass, Maximum Sustainable Yield, Size Distribution and Biodiversity of Demersal Large-scale Fisheries in Lake Malawi
papers.authors: Mulumpwa, M; Kaunda, E; Hara, M; Jere, W
papers.journal: African Journal of Food, Agriculture, Nutrition and Development
papers.abstract: This study was conducted to assess the fish biomass, biodiversity patterns and sustainable harvesting potential of demersal large-scale fisheries in Lake Malawi. This study aimed to determine appropriate fisheries output management target points (total allowable catch (TAC) and maximum sustainable yield (MSY)). The assessment was conducted in 2024 and was based on fish biomass survey data from 2020, which was conducted on Lake Malawi by the Department of Fisheries. A stern trawler (RV Ndunduma) was fitted with a bottom trawl net with a code-end mesh size of 38 mm. Biomass was estimated using the swept-area method and MSY was estimated using the Beddington and Cooke model. Shannon, Simpson and Pielou’s evenness indices were employed to assess biodiversity, while non-parametric statistical tests such as PERMANOVA and Kruskal-Wallis were used to determine differences in fish community composition and fish size distributions across the regions of the lake. The study estimated the total fish biomass and MSY of demersal fisheries in Lake Malawi at 261,297.8 tons and 130,648.9 tons per year, respectively. The southern region of the lake contributed the highest proportion of biomass and MSY, accounting for 55.6% of the total biomass. The study recorded high fish species richness (152), predominantly demersal fish species and very low densities of midwater fish species. The southern part of the lake recorded the highest fish species richness and abundance; however, it also showed a significant regional difference in community composition and fish size distribution. The findings further showed that the following commercially important fish species, Diplotaxodon, Lethrinops, and Rhamphochromis, in the southern part of the lake had smaller mean body sizes than in other regions, suggesting possible excessive fishing effort and growth overexploitation. The study also revealed limitations in the current fish biomass assessment approach, which is biased toward demersal species and may underestimate midwater fish stocks targeted by large-scale fishers. This study demonstrates that sustainable fishery management in Lake Malawi requires region-specific allocation of fishers, improved fish biomass assessment, stricter enforcement of fishery regulations and enhanced conservation measures. This will ensure that fish biodiversity is protected and that there is long-term fishery productivity. The findings provide scientific information for guiding fisheries policy, TAC allocation and ecosystem-based fisheries management in Malawi. Key words: Trawl fishery, fish biomass assessment, demersal fisheries and fisheries management
papers.summary_cn: 本研究基于2020年马拉维湖底拖网调查数据，采用扫掠面积法估算底层大型渔业的总鱼类生物量和最大可持续产量（MSY），并运用Beddington-Cooke模型及Shannon、Simpson等多样性指数评估物种多样性和规格分布。结果显示，全湖底层渔业总生物量约261,297.8吨，MSY约130,648.9吨/年，南部区域贡献了55.6%的生物量且物种丰富度最高（152种），但Diplotaxodon、Lethrinops和Rhamphochromis等经济鱼类的平均体长显著小于其他区域，提示过度捕捞和生长型过度开发。研究指出当前生物量评估方法偏向底层物种、可能低估中上层鱼类资源，建议按区域分配捕捞努力量、改进评估方法并加强执法与保护措施，为TAC分配和基于生态系统的渔业管理提供科学依据。

papers.title:
Comparative Performance of Oxford Nanopore Duplex and Simplex
                    <scp>16S rRNA</scp>
                    Reads for
                    <scp>eDNA</scp>
                    ‐Based Prediction of Salmon Aquaculture Benthic Impacts
papers.authors: Stoeck, Thorsten; Damm, Lukas; Breiner, Hans‐Werner; Katzenmeier, Sven; Filker, Sabine
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Environmental monitoring of salmon aquaculture increasingly uses eDNA‐based bacterial community profiling, yet the practical value of Oxford Nanopore duplex sequencing remains uncertain due to low yield. We compared full‐length 16S rRNA simplex and duplex Nanopore reads for predicting benthic environmental quality (EQ) at 15 Scottish salmon farms. After stringent Q30‐filtering, samples contained far more high‐quality simplex than duplex reads. Random Forest models trained on simplex data perfectly classified samples as above or below the good‐moderate EQ boundary (accuracy 100%, κ = 1), while duplex models reached 97.6% (κ = 0.95). For four‐class EQ predictions (good, moderate, poor, bad), simplex reads again performed better (80.5% accuracy, κ = 0.67) than duplex reads (73.2%, κ = 0.53). Taxonomic profiles of high‐impact samples were highly concordant across read types, sharing indicator taxa such as Sulfurovum , Lutimonas and Psychrobacter . In contrast, low‐impact samples showed reduced concordance due to higher diversity and insufficient duplex coverage. Nanopore sequencing also detected strong bacterial bioindicators absent from Illumina‐based studies, highlighting its potential for uncovering previously undetected diversity. Overall, duplex sequencing provided no advantage for EQ assessment. Nanopore simplex sequencing is therefore a viable option for eDNA‐based benthic monitoring, though further optimization is needed to improve throughput and scalability.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究比较了Oxford Nanopore双链与单链全长16S rRNA测序在基于eDNA预测苏格兰15个三文鱼养殖场底栖环境质量（EQ）中的表现。经Q30严格过滤后，单链高质量reads数量远超双链。Random Forest模型显示单链数据在二分类（good-moderate边界）中准确率达100%（κ=1），优于双链的97.6%（κ=0.95）；四分类EQ预测中单链同样更优（80.5% vs 73.2%）。高影响样本的指示类群（如Sulfurovum、Lutimonas、Psychrobacter）在不同read类型间高度一致，而低影响样本因多样性和双链覆盖不足一致性较低。总体而言，duplex测序对EQ评估无优势，Nanopore simplex测序可作为eDNA底栖监测的可行方案，但需进一步优化通量和可扩展性。

papers.title: Hierarchical Multi-Objective Dispatch of a Multi-Use Floating Offshore Wind–Hydrogen–Aquaculture System with OpenFAST-Informed Environmental Modeling
papers.authors: Lyu, Mao; Fu, Chunxiang; Zhou, Xiong; He, Huaijie; Yang, Lingang; Wang, Xiaohe
papers.abstract: Co-locating hydrogen production and aquaculture on floating offshore wind platforms requires dispatch policies that jointly optimize energy trading, electrolyzer longevity, and cage water quality—objectives that scalarized reinforcement learning struggles to reconcile. We develop a conservation-closed reduced-order model of a 20 MW-class floating wind system, driven by ERA5 North Sea reanalysis and cross-checked against OpenFAST, and cast dispatch as a Markov decision process. Scalarized twin delayed deep deterministic policy gradient (TD3) agents achieved nominally higher revenue than rule-based control (+0.033 M€; Hedges’ g = 0.94) but converged to a degenerate, hydrogen-abandoning equilibrium in 7% of independent runs (2/27). A hierarchical TD3 agent (H-TD3) with an annealed logarithmic Nash-bargaining reward showed no collapse across 20 seeds (Fisher’s exact test, p = 0.32), reached 95% of its final physical-objective level at the earliest observable episode in every seed, and exhibited an order-of-magnitude smaller plateau dispersion than scalarized baselines, with revenue statistically indistinguishable from rule-based control (1.216 ± 0.040 M€). Over 1000 h, H-TD3 increased cage biomass by 22.6% and yielded an electrolyzer-subsystem hydrogen cost of €3.05/kg (excluding electricity, wind-farm, and aquaculture costs), or €6.45/kg at €60/MWh wind electricity. These results frame multi-objective offshore dispatch as a risk-control problem: Nash-bargaining rewards produced fewer collapses than linear scalarization, though the difference was not significant.
papers.summary_cn: 研究针对多用途漂浮式海上风电-制氢-水产养殖系统，构建了基于ERA5北海再分析数据并经OpenFAST校验的20 MW级守恒封闭降阶模型，将调度问题建模为马尔可夫决策过程。标量化TD3智能体虽名义收益略高，但在7%的独立运行中收敛至放弃制氢的退化均衡；采用退火对数Nash议价奖励的分层TD3（H-TD3）在20个随机种子中均未出现崩溃，平台期离散度低一个数量级，收益与规则控制无显著差异（1.216 ± 0.040 M€）。1000小时内H-TD3使网箱生物量提高22.6%，电解槽子系统制氢成本为€3.05/kg（风电€60/MWh时为€6.45/kg）。结果表明Nash议价奖励较线性标量化可减少调度崩溃风险，但差异不显著。

papers.title: role of complex karyotype in the diagnosis of chronic lymphocytic leukemia: Integration of conventional cytogenetics and FISH analysis
papers.authors: Caliendo, Irene; Puopolo, Francesco; Fabbricatore, Carmela; Petrizzi, Valeria Belsito; Malferà, Giuseppe; Langella, Maria; Califano, Catello
papers.abstract: Complex karyotype (CK) is an emerging high-risk feature in chronic lymphocytic leukemia (CLL). We evaluated its diagnostic and prognostic relevance by integrating conventional cytogenetic analysis (CCA) and fluorescence in situ hybridization (FISH) in 30 patients. CCA identified CK in 23% of cases, including high-complexity profiles (≥5 abnormalities). FISH detected recurrent genomic lesions with established prognostic value: del(13q), trisomy 12, del(11q), del(17p). Integrated analysis improved detection of genomic complexity and refined risk stratification beyond single-lesion assessment. A representative case highlighted the ability of combined approaches to identify high-risk CK with TP53 disruption. These findings support routine integration of CCA and FISH for comprehensive cytogenetic profiling in CLL.

papers.title: Co-developing a human wellbeing-centered, socio-economic framework for small-scale fisheries: The Bahamas’ Nassau grouper fishery as a case study
papers.authors: Schuhbauer, Anna; Sherman, Krista D.; Kingon, Kelly; Patterson-Maura, Olivia; Smith, Nicola S.
papers.abstract: Most fisheries assessments focus on stock status and economic output but say little about the lived experiences of fishing communities, the cultural value of fisheries, or the governance conditions that decide whether regulations work. Guidance for broader socio-economic monitoring exists, but no single set of indicators fits every fishery; it has to be worked out in context, with the people whose wellbeing is being measured. Less is known about how this is done in practice. We describe, step by step, how general monitoring guidance was adapted with stakeholders into a wellbeing-centered, socio-economic framework for The Bahamas’ domestic fisheries, using the critically endangered Nassau grouper ( Epinephelus striatus ) as a case study. Twenty-eight participants from government, non-governmental organizations, research, and the value chain took part through meetings, surveys, a hybrid workshop, and interviews. Together they defined the scope, confirmed six wellbeing domains and prioritized 6 research themes. The resulting framework (Framework V01) contains 59 indicators across 20 attributes, including indicators of readiness for a prospective national seafood labeling program. We report the criteria used to select attributes and indicators and the minimum standards set for inclusive participation. T Participation was uneven, which shaped the framework and is discussed as a limitation. Framework V01 has not yet been tested in the field. Its content is specific to The Bahamas, but the documented process, including its compromises, offers a practical reference for others adapting wellbeing monitoring to their own fisheries.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究以巴哈马濒危的 Nassau grouper（Epinephelus striatus）渔业为案例，记录了如何将通用社会经济监测指南与利益相关方共同调整为以人类福祉为中心的小规模渔业框架。28名来自政府、非政府组织、科研和产业链的参与者通过会议、问卷、混合工作坊和访谈，界定了框架范围，确认了六个福祉领域并优先排序了6个研究主题。最终形成的 Framework V01 包含20个属性下的59项指标，其中包括国家海产品标签计划的准备度指标；作者报告了属性与指标的筛选标准及包容性参与的最低标准。参与度不均衡构成局限，且该框架尚未开展实地检验，但其流程记录为其他渔业适配福祉监测提供了实践参考。

papers.title: Analysis of policy networks in fisheries cultivation village program development: evidence from Kampar regency, Riau Province, Indonesia
papers.authors: Lubis, Ema Fitri; Sujianto; Yuliani, Febri; Marta, Auradian
papers.abstract: This study examines the relational and interpretive dimensions of policy-network implementation in the Fisheries Cultivation Village Program in XIII Koto Kampar District, Riau Province, Indonesia. The study employed a qualitative approach based on 15 semi-structured interviews conducted between April and May 2026, with interview data analysed thematically using NVivo 12 Plus. The findings show that program implementation involved differentiated actor roles, information flow, liaison and brokerage functions, trust relationships, and resource interdependence across organizational boundaries. Actors also demonstrated varying degrees of similarity in their definitions of implementation problems, particularly regarding feed/raw materials, market access, and capital, while identifying related solution areas including technical guidance, institutional strengthening, market access and downstreaming, and infrastructure improvement. These findings indicate that policy-network implementation involves both relational patterns and actors’ interpretations of problems and possible responses. The study contributes a relational–interpretive perspective that combines analysis of how actors interact with how they understand implementation challenges and formulate solution options. Rather than treating network positions, trust, interdependence, or shared problem definitions as indicators of implementation effectiveness, the study conceptualizes them as analytical features of how the policy network is organized, experienced, and interpreted.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究基于印尼廖内省Kampar县的渔业养殖村项目，采用定性方法对15名相关方进行半结构化访谈，运用NVivo 12 Plus进行主题分析，考察政策网络实施中的关系维度与解释维度。研究发现，项目实施涉及差异化的行动者角色、信息流动、联络与中介功能、信任关系及跨组织资源互依，行动者对饲料/原料、市场准入和资本等实施问题的界定存在不同程度的相似性，并识别出技术指导、机构强化、市场准入与下游化及基础设施改善等解决方案领域。研究提出关系—解释视角，将网络位置、信任、互依与共享问题界定视为政策网络组织、体验与解释的分析特征，而非实施效果的指标。

papers.title: Economic paradoxes and strategic determinants of sustainable aquaculture technology adoption: Empirical evidence from a logistic model
papers.authors: Tran, Quoc-Toan; Pham, Duy-Minh
papers.abstract: The adoption of sustainable aquaculture standards is promoted as a pathway toward food safety, environmental protection, and market upgrading, yet smallholder uptake often remains limited because compliance costs are immediate while market rewards are uncertain. This study examines that tension using a 2016–2017 survey of 240 aquaculture households in coastal Nam Dinh Province, Vietnam, comprising all 120 Vietnamese Good Agricultural Practices (VietGAP) households identified as actively implementing or preparing for VietGAP in the survey frame and 120 conventional households randomly selected from the same localities. Farm-level economic accounting is combined with a binary logistic model. VietGAP farms generated higher output values but also incurred substantially higher costs, producing lower mixed-income-to-intermediate-cost ratios than conventional farms. The original model estimates show strong associations between VietGAP participation, public technical training, and intensive or semi-intensive farming systems. Because the analytical sample was deliberately balanced by adoption status, these model outputs are interpreted as within-sample associations rather than population adoption probabilities. The study also draws on direct questionnaires with 45 market actors and 30 local officials to contextualize market coordination and policy conditions. The findings are presented as historical, mechanism-focused evidence from the early implementation phase of VietGAP rather than as a description of current prevalence. They suggest that sustainable aquaculture standards are more likely to scale when technical capability, market coordination, and compliance finance develop together.
papers.summary_cn: 基于越南南定省2016–2017年240户水产养殖户调查（120户VietGAP户与120户常规户），结合农场经济核算与二元logistic模型，分析了可持续水产养殖标准采纳的经济悖论与策略决定因素。VietGAP养殖户产值更高但成本显著增加，混合收入与中间成本之比低于常规户；模型显示VietGAP参与、公共技术培训与集约化/半集约化养殖系统存在强关联，但因样本按采纳状态平衡设计，结果仅解释为样本内关联。研究还结合45个市场主体和30名地方官员问卷，指出可持续养殖标准的推广有赖于技术能力、市场协调与合规融资的协同发展。

papers.title: Prevalence and abundance of pathogens in biofilters of freshwater recirculating aquaculture systems for Atlantic salmon (Salmo salar)
papers.authors: Fernando, Fernando; Krishna, Dhiraj; Petersen, Petra Elisabeth; Dahl, Maria Marjunardóttir; Vadstein, Olav; Christiansen, Debes Hammershaimb; Bakke, Ingrid
papers.abstract: The extent to which recirculating aquaculture system (RAS) biofilters contain pathogenic microorganisms is poorly understood. Previous studies have been limited to single facilities, offering little insight into pathogen prevalence across different systems. This study quantified the occurrence of three bacterial and four viral pathogens in 50 freshwater biofilters from 36 commercial RAS across 11 facilities in Norway and the Faroe Islands for Atlantic salmon using quantitative PCR (qPCR). We also characterized the bacterial community structure using 16S rRNA gene amplicon sequencing. Overall, pathogens were present at low abundance. Flavobacterium psychrophilum was detected in 35 of 50 biofilters (70%). Its highest abundance was estimated at 18.6 copies per ng template DNA or 0.015% relative to 16S rRNA gene copies. Yersinia ruckeri and Candidatus Branchiomonas cysticola were rare, detected in 4 (8%) and 1 (2%) biofilters, respectively. Infectious pancreatic necrosis virus (IPNV) was detected in 16 biofilters (32%). Avirulent infectious salmon anemia virus (ISAV-HPR0), Orthoreovirus piscis -1 (PRV-1), and salmon gill poxvirus (SGPV) were detected in 11 (22%), 6 (12%), and 3 (6%) biofilters, respectively. Microbial community analysis showed that heterotrophic bacterial genera, e.g., Flavobacterium , Aeromonas , Pseudomonas , and Mycobacterium , were commonly found in RAS biofilters.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究旨在明确大西洋鲑（Salmo salar）淡水RAS生物滤器中病原微生物的污染状况，采用qPCR对挪威和法罗群岛11个设施36套商业RAS的50个生物滤器进行3种细菌和4种病毒定量检测，并结合16S rRNA基因扩增子测序分析细菌群落结构。结果显示病原体总体丰度较低，Flavobacterium psychrophilum检出率最高（70%，35/50），Yersinia ruckeri和Candidatus Branchiomonas cysticola罕见；IPNV检出率为32%，ISAV-HPR0、PRV-1和SGPV分别为22%、12%和6%。微生物群落以Flavobacterium、Aeromonas、Pseudomonas和Mycobacterium等异养菌属为主。

papers.title: Smart aquaculture: an IoT-based monitoring and automation system for fish farming powered by solar energy
papers.authors: Ferdiansyah, Muhammad; Sari, Marlia; Damsir; Mariya, Lika; Arifin, Zaenal
papers.journal: Journal of Electrical Systems and Information Technology
papers.abstract: Abstract The growing demand for animal protein highlights aquaculture’s importance for food security, yet conventional practices face challenges in water-quality monitoring, operational efficiency, and energy sustainability. This study develops a solar-powered Internet of Things (IoT)-based Smart Aquaculture system integrating real-time water-quality monitoring, automated pumps, aerators, and feeders, and renewable energy supplied by a 300 Wp photovoltaic module and a 100 Ah battery. The system was evaluated through technical performance assessments and a 60-day cultivation experiment comparing conventional and IoT + solar ponds. Sensor measurements exhibited deviations of ≤ 5% from laboratory references, while data transmission achieved an average latency of 180 ms and a packet loss rate of 0.8%. Daily energy consumption averaged approximately 850 Wh/day, compared with photovoltaic generation of 1,200 Wh/day, resulting in a 70.8% load-to-generation ratio and an average energy surplus of 350 Wh/day under observed solar conditions. The IoT + solar pond demonstrated a 29.2% increase in average daily fish growth, a 10-percentage-point improvement in survival rate (82% to 92%), and a 17.1% reduction in feed conversion ratio (1.75 to 1.45). One-way analysis of variance (ANOVA) revealed a substantial difference in sampled final fish weights between groups (F(1,58) = 2417.16, p < 0.001). However, the absence of independent pond-level replication limits causal inference and broader generalizability. These findings demonstrate the technical feasibility of integrating IoT-based automation with photovoltaic energy for aquaculture operations, while indicating potential improvements in productivity and energy management. The proposed system provides a practical foundation for developing adaptive, energy-efficient, and sustainable aquaculture technologies, warranting further validation through independently replicated field trials.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究开发了一套太阳能供电的物联网（IoT）智能水产养殖系统，集成实时水质监测、自动水泵、增氧机和投饵机，由300 Wp光伏组件和100 Ah电池供能，并通过技术性能评估与60天养殖对比实验进行验证。传感器测量值与实验室参考值偏差≤5%，数据传输平均延迟180 ms、丢包率0.8%；日均能耗约850 Wh，光伏发电约1,200 Wh/d，负载发电比70.8%。与常规池塘相比，IoT+太阳能组鱼类日均生长提高29.2%，存活率由82%升至92%，饲料转化率由1.75降至1.45（单因素ANOVA，F(1,58)=2417.16，p<0.001），但缺乏独立池塘水平重复限制了因果推断与推广性。结果表明IoT自动化与光伏能源集成的技术可行性，并在生产力与能源管理方面具有提升潜力。

papers.title: Live bass, fish heads, and bacalao: ethnic supermarkets increase seafood access and strengthen food system resilience in a US urban system
papers.authors: Young, Talia; Yin, Feini; Dubik, Bradford; Kim, Jeannette; Provost, Mikaela M; Chen, C. J.; Jiang, Rachel; Lin, Zoe; Lhanyitsang, Sherab C; Acquafredda, Michael
papers.abstract: Ethnic supermarkets serving specific cultural communities have long provided alternatives to mainstream food retail systems; however, their role in seafood diversity and supply chain structure is poorly understood. To characterize product diversity and pricing, we surveyed non-frozen seafood products at supermarkets serving Asian, Black/Latin American/Caribbean, Eastern European, and “mainstream” communities in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania, USA, and conducted interviews with store staff to elucidate seafood procurement systems at different stores. The four types of stores offered significantly different product compositions from each other (i.e., different mixes of live organisms, whole finfish, fillets, and processed and packaged products). Asian supermarkets offered significantly greater diversity in seafood species (including higher proportions of wild-caught and domestic species) at significantly lower prices than other stores. Interviews suggested that seafood supply chains at the large chain businesses were typically highly centralized, while smaller and ethnic businesses tended to work with multiple and culturally specific providers, and in many cases put considerable effort into building a complex network of suppliers in order to obtain their desired seafood products. These results indicate that ethnic supermarkets provide critical access to culturally specific seafood products for a wide range of communities, in stark contrast to an increasingly homogenized mainstream seafood retail system. These ethnic markets further function as an established but in some ways underrecognized market for domestic seafood. They also provide an example of a non-corporate, alternative food system resilient to perturbations. Small-scale seafood harvesters and local seafood advocates could benefit from recognizing and building on these successful existing networks.
papers.summary_cn: 研究调查了美国费城服务亚裔、黑人/拉美/加勒比、东欧及主流社区的超市海产品多样性、定价与采购体系。亚裔超市的海产品种类多样性显著更高（野生及本土物种比例更高）且价格更低，四类超市产品构成差异显著。访谈显示大型连锁企业供应链高度集中，而小型及族裔企业多与文化特定供应商合作并构建复杂供应网络。族裔超市为多元社区提供了关键的文化特定海产品获取渠道，构成具有韧性的非企业化替代食物系统。

papers.title: Genome Evolution in Diploid Aegilops Species Assessed Using FISH with pTa-713, pTa-k566 and Oligo-45 Satellite DNA Families
papers.authors: Badaeva, Ekaterina D.; Ulyanov, Daniil S.; Razumova, Olga V.; Kotseruba, Violetta V.; Yurkina, Anna I.; Maida Jazmin, González Franco; Kuznetsova, Viktoria M.; Belousova, Maria Kh.; Chikida, Nadezhda N.; Tereshchenko, Nadezhda A.
papers.abstract: Repetitive DNAs are key drivers of genome evolution, but their dynamics accompanying the divergence of Aegilops genomes remain incompletely understood. Tandem repeats often serve as FISH markers in phylogenetic studies, however, few families have been used for evaluating relationships among Aegilops species. In this study, we employed three recently discovered satellite repeats, pTa-713, pTa-k566 and oligo-45, to analyze diploid Aegilops taxa to gain a deeper insight into the chromosomal mechanisms of genome evolution. We analyzed 121 accessions representing 11 diploid Aegilops species using these three probes and showed that they are effective for chromosome and genome identification in Aegilops. For each species, we established a generalized karyotype and assessed intra- and interspecific polymorphisms. Diploid genomes varied in repeat content and distribution; Ae. speltoides had the highest pTa-713 content, whereas D-, M- and N-genomes were highly abundant in oligo-45. The specific labelling patterns allowed us to subdivide Aegilops into six groups, mostly consistent with the taxonomic classification of the genus. FISH results showed that Ae. tauschii is karyotypically distinct from species of the Sitopsis group, which contradicts the affinity established via the analysis of low-copy DNA sequences. This controversy could be due to different evolutionary pathways between coding- and non-coding DNA fractions, introgressive hybridization and incomplete lineage sorting.
papers.summary_cn: 以FISH技术结合pTa-713、pTa-k566和oligo-45三个卫星重复序列探针，分析11个二倍体Aegilops物种共121份材料的基因组演化特征。各物种重复序列含量与分布存在差异，Ae. speltoides的pTa-713含量最高，D、M和N基因组富含oligo-45，标记模式可将Aegilops划分为6个类群，基本符合传统分类。Ae. tauschii与Sitopsis组物种的核型明显不同，与低拷贝DNA序列分析结果矛盾，可能源于编码与非编码DNA演化路径差异、渐渗杂交和不完全谱系分选。

papers.title: MDM2 Numeral Gain in Pleomorphic Lipoma and Spindle Cell Lipoma, A Retrospective FISH Study
papers.authors: Lazim, Ahmed F; Puthiyaveettil, Raghunath; Zhang, Paul J
papers.abstract: Spindle cell lipoma (SCL) and pleomorphic lipoma (PL) are characterized by an admixture of varying numbers of adipocytes and spindle cells and pleomorphic cells, respectively, set in a fibrous stroma with ropey collagen. MDM2 is typically amplified in atypical lipomatous tumors (ATL) but is not known to be amplified in SCL and PL. However, the MDM2 numeral abnormality in SCL and PL has not been well evaluated. Herein, we retrospectively evaluated MDM2 -FISH assays in SCL and PL. MDM2-FISH images in histologically and immunohistochemically confirmed SCL ( n = 28), PL ( n = 14), and conventional lipoma ( n = 7) as controls at the time of the diagnosis were retrieved, and MDM2 signals were enumerated. RFTM Poseidon MDM2 (12q15) and SE12 dual-colored probes (Kreatech) were used. One-way ANOVA analysis was performed. MDM2 signals/cell and MDM2 /SE12 ratio are as follows: 2.39 (range, 1.5-4.8) and 1.16 (range, 0.96-2.27) for SCL; 4.43 (range, 1-8.31) and 1.27 (range, 0.6-1.77) for PL; and 1.78 (range, 1.53-2.0) and 1.04 (range, 0.93-1.17) for conventional lipoma. The difference in MDM2/cell between lipoma and PL was significant ( P -value of 0.00360), and close to significance between lipomas and SCL ( P -value of 0.0681). MDM2/cell tended to be higher in PL than SCL; however, the difference did not reach statistical significance ( P -value of 0.65). No statistical difference was found in the MDM2 /SE12 ratio among the three groups. No MDM2 gene amplification was identified in the current study samples. The difference in MDM2 copy numbers between SCL/PL and lipoma suggests that SCL/PL might represent a less stable, more aneuploid state, as suggested by their spindle and pleomorphic morphology, compared to genetically more stable lipomas.
papers.summary_cn: 该回顾性FISH研究评估了多形性脂肪瘤（PL）和梭形细胞脂肪瘤（SCL）中MDM2基因拷贝数变化，以常规脂肪瘤为对照。结果显示PL的MDM2信号/细胞显著高于常规脂肪瘤（P=0.0036），SCL亦呈升高趋势（P=0.0681），但三组间MDM2/SE12比值无统计学差异，且未检出MDM2基因扩增。作者认为SCL/PL中MDM2拷贝数增多提示其基因组较常规脂肪瘤更不稳定、更趋向非整倍体状态，与其梭形和多形性形态学特征相符。

papers.title: Study on Retained Bycatch in a Traditional Small‐Scale Sero Trap Fishery in Bone Bay, Indonesia
papers.authors: Patangngari, Fijwal; Musbir, Musbir; Najamuddin; Sangeamwong, Thanakorn
papers.journal: New Zealand Journal of Marine and Freshwater Research
papers.abstract: Traditional sero fisheries support coastal livelihoods in Indonesia, yet their retained bycatch remains poorly documented. This case study quantified retained‐bycatch composition, catch per unit effort (CPUE) and assemblage structure in four sero units, a small‐scale stationary trap operating in seaweed‐farming, coral‐associated, mangrove and river‐mouth settings in Bone Bay. Over 120 hauls (February–May 2024), retained non‐target catch was classified as commercial bycatch (CB) or low‐value retained bycatch (LVB). Retained bycatch comprised 20,877 individuals and 476.0 kg from 85 taxa, and fishes contributed 97.4% of individuals. LVB made up 70.4% of individuals but 35.3% of biomass and was concentrated at the river‐mouth unit (90.8% of LVB individuals), where Ambassis vachellii dominated and salinity and water transparency were lowest. Generalised linear models showed significant station effects on CPUE for both fractions (all p < 0.001). CB abundance was highest at the mangrove unit (45.6 individuals 100 m −1 haul −1 ), whereas CB biomass was highest at the coral‐associated unit (2.86 kg 100 m −1 haul −1 ), reflecting mean individual weights of 18.5 and 126.0 g, respectively. PERMANOVA showed that assemblage structure differed among all stations ( R 2 = 0.36–0.48), although for LVB and total retained bycatch, dispersion also differed. These findings should be interpreted as a case study of four gear units rather than as generalisable habitat effects: each station was represented by a single sero unit, sampling covered only 4 months, habitat was confounded with mesh size and the fishing intensity of other gears around the stations was not quantified. Recording CB and LVB separately, in both abundance and biomass, is recommended for monitoring small‐scale fisheries, and replicated, longer‐term studies are needed before the patterns can be generalised.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究以印尼Bone Bay四个传统小型定置陷阱（sero）作业单元为对象，量化其保留性副渔获物（retained bycatch）的组成、CPUE及群落结构，区分商业性副渔获（CB）与低值保留副渔获（LVB）。120次作业共记录85个分类群、20,877尾、476.0 kg，鱼类占个体数97.4%；LVB占个体数70.4%但仅占生物量35.3%，集中于河口单元（以Ambassis vachellii为主）。GLM显示站点对两类CPUE均有显著影响，PERMANOVA表明各站点群落结构存在差异（R²=0.36–0.48）。作者建议小规模渔业监测应分别记录CB与LVB的数量和生物量，并指出该研究仅为四单元案例、生境与网目及捕捞强度混杂，需重复性长期研究方可推广。

papers.title: Trace element contamination and health risk assessment in coastal reef-associated fish from El-Khobar area, Arabian Gulf, Saudi Arabia
papers.authors: Younis, Alaa M.; Khairy, Mohamed; AL-Zbedy, Amnah S.; Elkady, Eman M.
papers.summary_cn: 该研究针对沙特阿拉伯阿拉伯湾El-Khobar沿岸礁区鱼类开展痕量元素污染水平调查，并评估其消费健康风险。

papers.authors: Adzijovski, Monique; Schultz, Aaron G.; Wos‐Oxley, Melissa L.; Oxley, Andrew P. A.; Afonso, Luis O.B.
papers.abstract: Abstract Rising water temperatures can disrupt host‐associated microbial communities important to fish metabolism, immunity and pathogen defence; however, the effects of prolonged thermal exposure and subsequent recovery remain poorly understood. We examined skin and gut bacterial assemblages of juvenile zebrafish under four temperature regimes: T1 (28°C for 60 days), T2 (28°C for 30 days followed by 34°C for 30 days), T3 (34°C for 30 days followed by 28°C for 30 days) and T4 (34°C for 60 days). Bacterial assemblages were profiled on days 1, 30 and 60 using full‐length 16S rRNA gene sequencing and analysis of resulting bacterial amplicon sequence variants. Gut community composition was comparatively stable across thermal treatments and showed limited overlap with water assemblages. In contrast, skin communities showed marked thermal sensitivity, with shifts in beta diversity, species richness and the relative abundance of commensal and potentially opportunistic taxa. Chronic heat exposure enriched Lysobacter , Rubrivivax , Gemmobacter and Pseudomonas and reduced Rhodobacter . Following cooling, T3 skin communities shifted towards control profiles, with increased overlap in core taxa, but did not fully return to the control state. These findings demonstrate tissue‐specific responses to prolonged warming and identify the skin bacterial community as a potential non‐invasive indicator of thermal perturbation and recovery.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究以斑马鱼为对象，设置四种温度情景（持续28°C、28°C转34°C、34°C转28°C及持续34°C），结合16S rRNA基因全长测序分析皮肤与肠道细菌群落对长期热暴露及降温恢复的响应。结果显示肠道菌群组成在热处理间相对稳定，与水体菌群重叠有限；而皮肤菌群表现出显著热敏感性，beta多样性、物种丰富度及共生与潜在机会性类群相对丰度均发生明显变化。持续热暴露富集 Lysobacter、Rubrivivax、Gemmobacter 和 Pseudomonas，减少 Rhodobacter；降温后皮肤群落向对照组趋近但未完全恢复。研究表明鱼类宿主相关菌群对升温的响应具有组织特异性，皮肤细菌群落可作为热扰动及恢复的非侵入性指示指标。

papers.authors: Smuk, Jessica A.; De Bonville, Jeremy; Bihun, Christian J.; Raby, Graham D.
papers.abstract: Abstract Metabolic rate is often assumed to be a trait that remains relatively consistent within individuals, with most variation attributed to environmental factors. However, few studies have quantified metabolic repeatability in fishes. We examined the short‐term repeatability of standard metabolic rate (SMR), absolute aerobic scope (AAS) and maximum metabolic rate (MMR) in yellow perch ( Perca flavescens; n = 15). Repeatability was moderate for SMR ( R = 0.318), mild for AAS ( R = 0.243) and poor for MMR ( R = 0.080), indicating modest within‐individual variability in metabolic measurements over a 32‐day experiment. More data on metabolic repeatability across varying contexts are needed to help understand within‐ and among‐individual variation.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究评估黄鲈（Perca flavescens）标准代谢率（SMR）、绝对有氧范围（AAS）和最大代谢率（MMR）的短期重复性（n=15，实验持续32天）。结果显示SMR重复性中等（R=0.318），AAS较弱（R=0.243），MMR极低（R=0.080），表明个体内代谢测定值存在一定变异。作者指出需在不同条件下积累更多代谢重复性数据，以理解个体内与个体间变异。

papers.authors: Herbig, Jennifer; Loewen, Tracey; Fisher, Jonathan A. D.; Niemi, Andrea; Bouchard, Caroline; Else, Brent; Nickoloff, Gina; Walker, Zoe; Michel, Christine; Pućko, Monika
papers.abstract: Abstract As a key forage fish in the Arctic, Arctic cod ( Boreogadus saida ) plays a critical role in transferring energy in Arctic marine ecosystems. While understanding Arctic cod population dynamics within the context of a rapidly warming Arctic could provide essential information for regional conservation efforts, it remains elusive. Here, we postulate that the isotopic ratio of oxygen ( 18 O: 16 O, expressed as δ 18 O) in otoliths can be used to reconstruct both the thermal and spatial history of Arctic cod across the Canadian Arctic and provide insights into future population dynamics. Otoliths grow throughout the life of a fish and incorporate oxygen stable isotopes proportionate to ambient concentrations following a temperature‐dependent fractionation, thereby reflecting the thermal habitats utilized by Arctic cod through their lifetime. Here, we measured δ 18 O in otoliths from 370 Arctic cod caught across the Canadian Arctic. We derived in‐situ fractionation equations inclusive of an age component, compared these with available laboratory‐derived equations, and estimated ambient temperature at larval stages of fish development. We further modelled the effects of ambient temperature experienced during otolith core formation on standard length‐at‐age using a generalized linear model to better understand the effects of warming temperatures on Arctic cod. The results of our study confirm ontogenetic vertical migration of Arctic cod from the epipelagic layer (0–100 m) to the deeper Atlantic water mass (>100 m) within the first year of life. However, the lack of regional small‐scale variation in δ 18 O values within deeper Atlantic waters that fish used impeded the detection of regional horizontal movements at depth based solely on this tracer. Analyses of δ 18 O also showed that Arctic cod experiencing warmer temperatures during early life stages are smaller around age of maturity, suggesting applicability of the temperature‐size rule. Thus, the effects of increasing surface water temperatures in the Canadian Arctic could propagate through the marine food web. While oxygen isotopes in otoliths are a promising way to monitor the effects of temperature on Arctic cod growth in the Canadian Arctic, work remains to realize the full potential of this tool to identify shifts in habitat use.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究通过测定加拿大北极地区370尾北极鳕（Boreogadus saida）耳石中的δ¹⁸O，重建其热经历与空间移动历史，并建立包含年龄组分的原位分馏方程以估算幼体阶段的环境温度。结果证实北极鳕在生命第一年内由表层（0–100 m）向深层大西洋水团（>100 m）进行个体发育垂直迁移，但深层水团中δ¹⁸O缺乏区域小尺度变异，限制了仅凭该指标检测深层水平移动的能力。耳石核心形成期经历较高温度的个体在成熟年龄时体型较小，符合温度-体型规则（temperature-size rule），表明加拿大北极表层水温升高可能通过食物网产生级联效应。

papers.title: Fish Species Diversity, Seasonal Dynamics and Land Use Land Cover Associations With Fish Assemblages in the Gulf of Lake Tana, Ethiopia
papers.authors: Tsegaye, Birtukan; Mingist, Minwyelet; Getahun, Abebe; Mengistu, Daniel; Aemro, Degsera; Erarto, Felegush; Zelalem, Wonde; Mequanent, Dagnew
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Lake Tana, Ethiopia, harbours the world's only remaining cyprinid species flock, making it globally significant for conservation. Yet, these resources face mounting anthropogenic pressures from overfishing and land use changes.
