We assessed fish assemblage structure and seasonal dynamics in the Gulf of Lake Tana from September 2024 to August 2025 and land use land cover (LULC) changes from 2000 to 2025 using Landsat and Sentinel imagery. Fish specimens were sampled monthly from fishers at landing sites employing gillnets of varying mesh sizes. The specimens were identified to species level and analysed using Shannon diversity ( H ′), evenness ( J ), dominance ( C ) and Index of Relative Importance (%IRI). Exploratory multivariate analyses (non‐metric multidimensional scaling [NMDS] and principal component analysis [PCA] of four seasonal aggregates) were used to describe seasonal assemblage patterns. A total of 2764 specimens representing 18 species were recorded, dominated by endemic Labeobarbus spp. (81.8%), followed by Oreochromis niloticus (11.9%) and Clarias gariepinus (6.3%). Diversity was moderate ( H ′ = 2.60) and differed significantly among four hydrological seasons (individual‐based permutation test, 9999 permutations: p = 0.0024), being highest in the dry season ( H ′ = 2.596). After Bonferroni correction, dry‐season H ′ differed significantly from pre‐rainy (Hutcheson t ‐test, t = 3.84, adjusted p = 0.0006) and post‐rainy H ′ ( p = 0.036), but not from rainy‐season H ′ (adjusted p = 0.066). Evenness was high in all seasons ( J = 0.87–0.95). Sex ratios were female‐biased in the catches of 12 of 18 species ( χ 2 , p < 0.001). Between 2000 and 2025, cropland and settlements expanded to nearly 60% of the mapped area, whereas wetlands declined by 92.7%. Because, fish data cover a single year and no environmental covariates were measured, these LULC trends are presented only as landscape context that is associated with the current assemblage composition. The findings provide baseline data for further studies, testing these associations directly, and support the need for watershed rehabilitation, buffer zone protection and sustained fisheries monitoring to protect the lake's globally unique cyprinid flock.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究评估了埃塞俄比亚塔纳湖湾鱼类群落结构、季节动态及2000—2025年土地利用/覆被（LULC）变化，基于2024年9月至2025年8月按月采集的2764尾标本（18种）及Landsat/Sentinel影像分析。群落以特有Labeobarbus spp.为主（81.8%），Shannon多样性中等（H′=2.60），四个水文季节间差异显著（p=0.0024），旱季最高；18种中12种性比偏雌。2000—2025年耕地与居民点扩张至约占60%，湿地减少92.7%，但鱼类数据仅覆盖一年且未测环境协变量，LULC趋势仅作景观背景关联呈现。

papers.title: Impact of Selected Monetary Policy Instruments on Fish Trade Flow in Nigeria For The Period 1970-2024
papers.authors: Jegede, R. O.; Coker, A. A. .A.; Baba, K. M.; Ojo, A. O.
papers.abstract: Purpose: This study therefore examines the impact of selected MP instruments on FISTR flow in Nigeria over the period 1970–2024. Design/Methodology/Approach: The study adopts an ex-post facto research design and relies on annual time-series secondary data covering the period 1970–2024 in Nigeria. The dataset comprises 55 annual observations for the study variables, sourced from official publications of the Central Bank of Nigeria (CBN) Statistical Bulletin and World Development Indicators (WDI) of the World Bank. The Autoregressive Distributed Lag (ARDL) model is employed to estimate the short-run and long-run relationships among the variables. To assess the robustness of the ARDL estimates, Fully Modified Ordinary Least Squares (FMOLS), Dynamic Ordinary Least Squares (DOLS), and Canonical Cointegrating Regression (CCR) estimators are also employed. Research Limitation: The study focuses exclusively on five monetary policy variables, excluding other potentially relevant factors such as trade openness, fuel prices, fisheries infrastructure, government expenditure, climate variability and institutional quality. Findings: The ARDL bounds test confirms the existence of a long-run equilibrium relationship among the variables. The long-run estimates reveal that EXR and interest rate (INTR) significantly promote FISTR, whereas inflation (INF) and foreign reserves (LFREV) exert significant adverse effects, while money supply (MS) has a positive but insignificant influence. In the short run, EXR and INF initially depress FISTR, whereas INTR and MS stimulate trade after short lags. The error correction term indicates that approximately 74.2% of short-run disequilibrium is corrected annually. The FMOLS, DOLS and CCR estimators largely validate the ARDL results, confirming the robustness of the findings. Practical Implication: Directing monetary expansion towards productive fisheries financing and strategically utilising foreign reserves for infrastructure development can strengthen cold-chain facilities, storage, processing capacity, transportation, and export infrastructure. Social Implication: It will improve the well-being of fishing and processing communities and the affordability of fish as a source of animal protein. Originality/Value: Beyond methodological novelty, it demonstrates that fisheries trade performance is shaped not only by sector-specific factors but also by broader macroeconomic conditions. These findings provide new insights for designing monetary policies that support fisheries financing, trade competitiveness, and sustainable industry development.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究基于1970–2024年尼日利亚年度时间序列数据，采用ARDL模型及FMOLS、DOLS、CCR等估计方法，考察货币政策工具对鱼类贸易流（fish trade flow）的短期与长期影响。ARDL边界检验确认变量间存在长期均衡关系；长期估计显示汇率（EXR）和利率（INTR）显著促进鱼类贸易，通胀（INF）和外汇储备（LFREV）则具显著抑制作用，货币供应（MS）影响为正但不显著；误差修正项表明每年约74.2%的短期失衡得到修正。研究建议将货币扩张导向渔业生产性融资，并战略性地运用外汇储备支持冷链、加工与出口基础设施建设。

papers.title: Interaction Mechanism Between Grass Carp (Ctenopharyngodon idella) Fish Maw Collagen and Heavy-Metal Ions
papers.authors: Feng, Qianqian; Xu, Wei; Yan, Xu; Ramaswamy, Hosahalli S.; Azarakhsh, Nima; Wang, Chao
papers.abstract: Heavy-metal residues in fish maw are closely associated with its collagen fraction, yet the binding behavior and molecular mechanism of grass carp (Ctenopharyngodon idella) fish maw collagen toward common metal ions remain poorly characterized. To address this, hot-water-soluble collagen (HSC) and acetic acid soluble collagen (ASC) were extracted and characterized via SDS-PAGE, UV spectroscopy, zeta-potential measurement and amino acid analysis. Adsorption isotherms, fluorescence, CD and SEM-EDX were used to probe binding with Cu(II), Hg(II), Cd(II), and Cr(III). Dried fish maw contained 56.907 ± 0.319 g/100 g of protein and 25.01% collagen. In the four-ion mixed competitive system containing Cu(II), Hg(II), Cd(II) and Cr(III), the Langmuir and Freundlich models were applied only as empirical fitting tools, and the fitted parameters are apparent values under competition. Cd(II) showed the highest apparent adsorption capacity, while Cu(II), Cr(III) and Hg(II) exhibited stronger apparent affinity; Cu(II), Hg(II) and Cd(II) were better described by the Langmuir model, whereas Cr(III) was better described by the Freundlich model. Cu(II), Cr(III), and Hg(II) triggered static fluorescence quenching. The binding of Cr(III) and Hg(II) may involve hydrophobic interactions, while the binding of Cu(II) may involve hydrogen bonds and van der Waals forces, and it may also result from the non-specific intermolecular aggregation of collagen induced by Cu(II). Low-concentration Cr(III) disrupted collagen ellipticity bands and induced disordered conformations. This work deepens the mechanistic understanding of heavy-metal binding to fish maw collagen and offers fundamental insights for future relevant research.
papers.summary_cn: 以草鱼鱼鳔为原料提取热水溶性胶原（HSC）和酸溶性胶原（ASC），结合吸附等温模型、荧光猝灭、CD及SEM-EDX等手段，研究其对Cu(II)、Hg(II)、Cd(II)、Cr(III)的吸附行为与分子机制。在四离子竞争体系中，Cd(II)表观吸附容量最高，而Cu(II)、Cr(III)、Hg(II)表观亲和力更强；Cu(II)、Hg(II)、Cd(II)符合Langmuir模型，Cr(III)符合Freundlich模型。Cu(II)、Cr(III)、Hg(II)均引起静态荧光猝灭，Cr(III)和Hg(II)结合可能涉及疏水相互作用，Cu(II)结合可能涉及氢键与范德华力；低浓度Cr(III)可破坏胶原椭圆率谱带并诱导无序构象。

papers.title: Fished to the Edge: Severe Overfishing Threatens Fish Stocks in Tanzania's Saline Rift Valley Lakes
papers.authors: Said, Hadija Hussein; Mwandya, Augustine W.; Mwakosya, Catherine A.; Materu, Silvia F.; Rumisha, Cyrus
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT The Saline Rift Valley Lakes (SRVLs) of Tanzania support important inland fisheries, but increasing fishing pressure threatens their sustainability. This study assessed the status of fish stocks in two Tanzanian SRVLs: Lakes Kitangiri and Singida. Data on catches, species composition, catch per unit effort, maturity stages, and length‐based indicators were collected from May to September 2023. Results indicate strong evidence of overfishing, reflected in declining catches and high exploitation rates. The endemic Oreochromis amphimelas (Manyara tilapia) was the most affected species, with exploitation rates (> 0.9) and fishing mortality 13‐18 times above sustainable reference points. Length‐frequency data showed that most individuals were captured before reaching optimal size. All sampled O. amphimelas exhibited small body depths relative to the legal 7.62 cm gill‐net mesh size, and a high proportion of individuals were immature or early maturing. Interviews revealed widespread use of small‐mesh nets, contributing to the capture of undersized fish. However, some individuals matured at relatively small sizes, suggesting possible shifts in population structure linked to environmental stressors. These findings reveal a mismatch between current mesh size regulations and the biological characteristics of target species. Revising gear regulations and adopting species‐specific management measures are recommended to improve fisheries sustainability in SRVL.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究评估了坦桑尼亚Kitangiri和Singida两个盐碱裂谷湖的鱼类种群状况，基于2023年5–9月的渔获量、物种组成、CPUE、性成熟阶段及体长指标数据。结果显示过度捕捞证据充分，特有种Oreochromis amphimelas受害最重，开发率超过0.9，捕捞死亡率达可持续参考点的13–18倍，多数个体在达到适宜规格前即被捕获。小网目网具的广泛使用是导致幼鱼捕获的主因，现行网目法规与目标种的生物学特征不匹配，建议修订渔具规定并实施物种特异性管理措施。

papers.title: A new species of P imelodella ( H eptapteridae: R hamdiinae) from the upper B ermejo basin, northwestern L a P lata basin
papers.authors: Cortés‐Hernández, Miguel Ángel; Alonso, Felipe; Slobodian, Veronica; Márquez‐Fernández, Edna Judith; Terán, Guillermo Enrique; Pierre, Veida; Aguilera, Gastón
papers.abstract: Abstract A new species of Pimelodella occurring in the upper Bermejo basin is described using morphological and genetic data. The new species is distinguished from most congeners by having fewer total vertebrae (37–39), short adipose‐fin base (20.3%–25.2% of L S ), maxillary barbel almost reaching or reaching the origin of the adipose fin, subequal lobes of caudal fin or upper lobe slightly longer, supraoccipital process articulating with the anterior nuchal plate and epiphyseal branch of supraorbital canal on the head ending in a single sensory pore (s6 + s6). The type locality of the new species is situated in the transition zone between the Yunga and Dry Chaco terrestrial ecoregions near the area of influence of Parque Nacional El Rey. Considering the high anthropogenic impact resulting from agricultural activities in the region and the high level of endemism present in the upper Bermejo basin, the new species could be categorized as Endangered (EN) in a future formal assessment, following the IUCN criteria.
papers.summary_cn: 描述阿根廷西北部La Plata盆地上Bermejo流域发现的Pimelodella属新种，基于形态与遗传数据将其与同属多数物种区分，主要鉴别特征为总椎骨数较少（37–39）、短脂鳍基及上颌须几乎达脂鳍起点等。模式产地处于Yunga与Dry Chaco生态区过渡带、El Rey国家公园影响范围内，鉴于该区域农业活动的人为干扰及高特有性，作者建议未来按IUCN标准将其评估为濒危（EN）。

papers.title: Ageing imprecision compounds the effects of fishing selectivity, increasing bias in estimates of growth parameters
papers.authors: Chamberlin, Derek W.
papers.abstract: Abstract Accurately estimating fish growth is critical for fisheries management, but growth parameter estimates are often affected by multiple sources of error. While the independent effects of ageing error and fishing selectivity are well documented, their combined effects remain unknown. This study used a simulation approach to determine how ageing imprecision and selectivity (logistic and dome‐shaped) compound when estimating growth parameters across four rockfish ( Sebastes spp.) life histories. Results demonstrated that ageing imprecision and selectivity exacerbate biases in growth parameter estimates that exceed the error caused by selectivity alone, while selectivity was the primary driver in estimating size‐at‐age. The magnitude of this compounded bias was heavily dependent on the species' life history and the shape of the selectivity curve. Because growth parameters are frequently used as proxies for critical stock benchmarks like natural mortality and stock depletion, these compounded errors could distort population models. Current growth models fail to account for both sources of error simultaneously, highlighting the critical need to develop integrated frameworks that account for both ageing imprecision and selectivity.
papers.summary_cn: 研究采用模拟方法，评估年龄鉴定不精确性与渔业选择性（logistic与dome-shaped）对四种岩鱼（Sebastes spp.）生活史类型生长参数估计的复合影响。结果表明，年龄鉴定误差与选择性共同加剧了生长参数估计偏差，其幅度超过选择性单独作用，且复合偏差大小高度依赖物种生活史与选择性曲线形状；选择性则是size-at-age估计的主要驱动因素。由于生长参数常被用作自然死亡率和资源衰退等关键stock benchmarks的替代指标，这种复合误差可能扭曲种群模型。现有生长模型未能同时纳入两类误差来源，亟需构建整合年龄鉴定不精确性与选择性的综合框架。

papers.title: A systematic scoping review and conceptual framework for climate smart decision support systems in inland small scale fisheries in Zimbabwe and the SADC region
papers.authors: Chisadza, Bright; Muchuweti, Maud
papers.summary_cn: 该综述针对津巴布韦及SADC地区内陆小规模渔业，系统梳理气候智能决策支持系统的研究现状并构建概念框架，旨在为气候适应型渔业管理提供决策工具支撑。

papers.title: Water Quality Parameters, Freshwater Fish Assemblages and Anthropogenic Disturbances in Looc Lake, Castillejos, Zambales, Philippines
papers.authors: Ventura, Mikey B.; Corpuz, Mark Nell C.
papers.abstract: Background: Looc Lake in Castillejos, Zambales, Philippines, supports local fisheries, but baseline information on its fish assemblages, water quality and anthropogenic pressures remains limited. Aims: The study provided a preliminary assessment of freshwater fish assemblages, evaluated water quality parameters, and identified potential anthropogenic threats in Looc Lake, Castillejos, Zambales, Philippines. Study Design: Spatial rapid bioassessment and environmental monitoring across five designated sampling stations covering the eastern, western, northern, southern and central regions of a shallow tropical floodplain lake. Place and Duration of Study: Looc Lake, Castillejos, Zambales, Luzon Island, Philippines. Sampling was conducted during daytime hours (06:00–10:00 h). Methodology: Fish specimens were collected using gill nets (mesh size 7–10 cm), cast nets, and fish traps deployed for four hours per station. Species were identified, counted, and analysed for relative abundance, diversity, dominance, evenness, catch per unit effort, and Bray-Curtis similarity. In-situ water quality parameters (pH, dissolved oxygen, water temperature, and Secchi disk visibility depth) were recorded alongside colourimetric tests for ammonia and nitrates. Anthropogenic activities were documented through observational assessments. Results: Water quality parameters indicated slightly alkaline, well-oxygenated, and temperatures within the reported range. A total of 1,611 individuals belonging to six families and eight non-native fish species were recorded, of which the fish assemblages were heavily dominated by the invasive black-chin tilapia (Sarotherodon melanotheron). All fish species were classified as non-native. Diversity indices revealed low species richness and high dominance. Based on the Bray-Curtis similarity analysis, fish assemblages exhibited high spatial homogeneity and minimal turnover across the lake stations, with similarity indices ranging from 0.60 to 0.89. However, the studied floodplain lake faces ecological pressures from solid waste dumping, macrophyte overgrowth, quarrying-induced siltation, and seasonal desiccation. Conclusion: Looc Lake exhibits low fish biodiversity dominated by invasive exotic cichlids, alongside environmental pressures from solid waste and nearby quarrying. Sustainable management policies and continuous monitoring are essential to conserve the lake's ecological integrity and local fishing livelihoods.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究对菲律宾Zambales省Looc湖的淡水鱼类群落、水质参数及人为干扰进行了初步评估，在五个采样站开展空间快速生物评价与环境监测。共记录8种非本地鱼类（隶属6科）1611尾，群落由入侵种黑颏罗非鱼（Sarotherodon melanotheron）高度主导，物种丰富度低、优势度高，各站间Bray-Curtis相似性为0.60–0.89，空间同质性明显。水质呈弱碱性、溶氧良好，但湖泊面临固废倾倒、大型水生植物过度生长、采石导致的淤积及季节性干涸等生态压力。研究建议制定可持续管理政策并持续监测，以维护湖泊生态完整性与当地渔业生计。

papers.title: Habitat segregation of endemic and invasive fish species across interconnected lentic and lotic ecosystems in an urban aquatic system: insight from environmental DNA analysis
papers.authors: Won, Suyeon; Kang, Yujin; Song, Youngkeun
papers.summary_cn: 该研究利用环境DNA（eDNA）技术，调查城市水生系统中特有鱼类与入侵鱼类在相互连通的静水（lentic）和流水（lotic）生态系统间的栖息地分化格局，旨在揭示两类鱼群在不同水体类型中的空间分布差异与共存机制。

papers.title: Correction: Hydrological threshold-based ecological water withdrawal management for protecting fish egg and larval drift in a large water-transfer project
papers.authors: Xiong, Ling; Zhou, Song-Tao; Yan, Tao; Jiang, You-Gao; He, Bin; Cheng, Juan; Nie, Xin; Qin, Xiao-Yu; Ran, Zhi-Xian; Tian, Wei
papers.summary_cn: 该文为对一项基于水文阈值的生态取水管理研究的更正，原研究旨在通过设定水文阈值来保护大型引水工程中鱼类卵和仔鱼的漂流过程。因缺少摘要，具体方法与结果无法概述。

papers.title: Fish Species Composition, Relative Abundance and Diversity of Nworie  River, Imo State, Nigeria
papers.authors: Ukagwu, John I.; Nwosu, Chijioke Ralph; Nkulo, Uzoma U.; Ezekiel, Michael Ndako; Emeka-Ohia, Priscillia
papers.journal: Asian Journal of Fisheries and Aquatic Research
papers.abstract: This study assessed fish species composition, relative abundance and diversity in Nworie River, Imo State, Nigeria, using fish-catch records obtained between January and August 2026. The assessment aimed to establish a baseline for subsequent biodiversity monitoring and fisheries management. Records were drawn from three sampling stations representing the upstream (A), midstream (B) and downstream (C) sections of the river. Specimens were collected fortnightly using a gill net and a dugout canoe, and records were pooled across stations. Species abundance and relative abundance were summarised descriptively, while Simpson’s dominance, diversity and reciprocal indices were calculated to characterise the recorded assemblage. The dataset comprised 1,652 fish specimens assigned to 12 species across four families. Cichlidae accounted for 80.93% of the total catch. Haemichromis fasciatus was the most frequently recorded species (255 specimens; 15.44%), followed by Pelmatolapia marae (239; 14.47%), Oreochromis aureus (209; 12.65%), Sarotherodon galilaeus (187; 11.32%) and Oreochromis niloticus (179; 10.84%). Together, these five-species represented 64.71% of all recorded individuals. Haemichromis elongartus was the least abundant recorded species (13; 0.79%). Simpson’s dominance, diversity and reciprocal indices were 0.1075, 0.8925 and 9.30, respectively. The findings indicate unequal numerical representation among the recorded species and provide an initial fish assemblage inventory for Nworie River. Because the analysis concerns pooled catch records, the estimates should not be interpreted as absolute population abundances. Continued taxonomic verification and effort-standardised monitoring are recommended.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究基于2026年1—8月尼日利亚Nworie河上游、中游和下游三个采样站的渔获记录，分析鱼类物种组成、相对丰度和多样性，以建立生物多样性监测与渔业管理的基线。共记录4科12种1,652尾鱼，Cichlidae占总渔获的80.93%，其中Haemichromis fasciatus最多（15.44%），Haemichromis elongartus最少（0.79%）。Simpson优势度、多样性和倒数指数分别为0.1075、0.8925和9.30，表明物种数量分布不均。由于分析基于合并渔获记录，结果不应解释为绝对种群丰度，建议继续开展分类学验证和努力量标准化的监测。

papers.title: Medium stocking density of Labeo rohita optimizes fish growth, nutrient recycling, and rice productivity in an integrated rice-fish co-culture system
papers.authors: Arshad, Shamoona; Kamara, Abdulai Merry; Inayat, Muhammad; Shah, Tufail; Sherzada, Shahid; Hou, Mengna
papers.summary_cn: 该研究在稻鱼共作系统中考察不同放养密度对罗胡鱼（Labeo rohita）生长、养分循环及水稻产量的影响，以确定最优放养密度。结果表明中等放养密度可兼顾鱼类生长、养分回收与水稻生产力。

papers.title: Circular Bioeconomy in Organic Waste Management: Maggot Cultivation from Organic Waste and its Utilization for Agriculture, Aquaculture and Livestock in Indonesia
papers.authors: Jupesta, Joni; Permana, Indra; Sahari, Bandung; Gheewala, Shabbir H.
papers.summary_cn: 该文探讨印度尼西亚有机废弃物管理中的循环生物经济模式，重点介绍利用有机废弃物养殖蝇蛆（maggot）并将其产物用于农业、水产养殖和畜牧业的路径。因无摘要，仅据标题作此简介。

papers.title: UV-C Irradiation Modulates Carbon and Nitrogen Cycles in Nile Tilapia Recirculating Aquaculture Systems
papers.authors: Fadhilah, Iqbal Sulthon; Rahardjo, Seto Sugianto Prabowo; Supriatin, Febriyani Eka; Nuswantoro, Soko; Pratiwi, Arum; Fadjar, Mohamad; Yuwanita, Rani
papers.abstract: Recirculating aquaculture systems (RASs) continuously accumulate organic carbon and nitrogen, relying on microbial nutrient-reduction efficiency to support fish production performance. Previous UV-C studies in aquaculture have focused on disinfection and pathogen control, with limited research on carbon–nitrogen dynamics. This study evaluated continuous UV-C irradiation in a RAS for 30 days using Nile tilapia (Oreochromis niloticus), comparing conventional and UV-C-treated systems with three replicates each (n = 3). Water quality, carbon and nitrogen dynamics, bacterial abundance, plankton density, and fish production were monitored throughout the experimental period. UV-C was associated with 59.1% and 59.2% reductions in estimated organic carbon and the carbon accumulation rate, respectively. Bacterial abundance and plankton density decreased by 69.1% and 26.7%, coinciding with reduced capacity of microbial and planktonic nutrient sinks within the system. UV-C irradiation was able to reduce NH4+, and NO3− up to 22.0% and 10.6%, respectively. Higher NO2− in UV-C was increased to 1.08 mg/L due to shifts in carbon availability and microbial community structure. Residual nitrogen increased by 17.7% because nitrogen fluxes shifted toward assimilative pathways. Consequently, nitrogen utilization efficiency improved, as reflected by higher nitrogen efficiency factor, nitrification ratio, and nitrogen–carbon transformation ratio. UV-C treatment increased final biomass by 14.1%, achieved 100% survival, and reduced FCR by 24.3% compared with Ct, suggesting its potential to modify carbon–nitrogen dynamics and improve resource-use efficiency in RAS.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究在尼罗罗非鱼（Oreochromis niloticus）RAS中连续30天施加UV-C照射，比较常规系统与UV-C处理系统的水质、碳氮动态、细菌丰度、浮游生物密度及鱼类生产性能（各3重复）。UV-C使估算有机碳及碳积累速率分别降低59.1%和59.2%，细菌丰度与浮游生物密度分别下降69.1%和26.7%，NH4+和NO3−降低达22.0%和10.6%，但NO2−升至1.08 mg/L，残余氮增加17.7%。氮通量转向同化途径，氮利用效率提高，终末生物量增加14.1%，存活率达100%，FCR降低24.3%，表明UV-C可调控RAS碳氮动态并提升资源利用效率。

papers.title: Developmental locomotor regimes in Atlantic salmon: wild ontogeny and intensive aquaculture
papers.authors: Pérez-Lefimil, Francisco; Guzmán, Neftalí; Rojas, Eduardo; Márquez, José Luis
papers.summary_cn: 该研究关注大西洋鲑（Atlantic salmon）在野生个体发育与集约化养殖条件下的运动发育模式差异，比较自然ontogeny与养殖环境对 locomotor 发育的影响。摘要缺失，具体方法与结果无法获知。

papers.title: Upcycling Gelatin Capsule Waste into Lysozyme-Loaded Active Films: Characterization and Application for Preserving the Quality of Semi-Dried Striped Snakehead Fish
papers.authors: Woraprayote, Weerapong; Janyaphisan, Thitiphorn; Chinarak, Khanittha; Kumnerdsiri, Pudthaya; Uchuwittayakul, Anurak; Kaewprachu, Pimonpan; Pongsetkul, Jaksuma; Sai-ut, Samart; Rawdkuen, Saroat; Kingwascharapong, Passakorn
papers.abstract: Valorization of gelatin capsule waste as a functional packaging material could simultaneously reduce industrial by-products and dependence on petroleum-based plastics. In this study, gelatin capsule waste was converted into active films containing hen egg white lysozyme (HEWL; 0–3.0%, w/v), and the effects of HEWL incorporation on physicochemical, mechanical, barrier, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties were investigated. The films remained visually transparent and exhibited strong ultraviolet-shielding properties, with negligible transmittance in the 200–300 nm range. HEWL incorporation improved the films’ thermal and physicochemical properties, as evidenced by reductions in moisture content (21.79 to 20.68%), water solubility (50.17 to 43.50%), swelling (777 to 406%), and water vapor permeability (5.34 to 4.20 × 10−4 g·mm·m−2·h−1·Pa−1). Tensile strength increased from 29.65 MPa in the control film to a maximum of 35.55 MPa at 1.5% HEWL, whereas elongation at break remained unchanged (p ≥ 0.05). The glass transition temperature (Tg) progressively increased from 29.78 to 41.03 °C with increasing HEWL concentration. At 3.0% HEWL, the ABTS radical-scavenging capacity and ferric-reducing antioxidant power increased by 1.10-fold and 1.48-fold, respectively. Furthermore, HEWL-containing films exhibited antibacterial activity against the tested foodborne bacteria, with Gram-positive bacteria showing greater susceptibility than Gram-negative bacteria. The film formulation containing 2.0% HEWL was subsequently evaluated for preserving semi-dried striped snakehead fish during room-temperature storage. Compared with the HEWL-free gelatin film, the HEWL-containing film retarded microbial proliferation and lipid oxidation while maintaining product moisture over 3 days of storage. Overall, these findings demonstrate the potential of valorizing gelatin capsule waste into a bioactive packaging matrix and support the development of HEWL-loaded films for the short-term preservation of semi-dried aquatic products.
papers.summary_cn: 以明胶胶囊废弃物为基质制备含溶菌酶（HEWL）的活性膜，考察HEWL添加量（0–3.0%）对膜理化、机械、阻隔、抗氧化及抗菌性能的影响。HEWL提升了膜的拉伸强度（最高35.55 MPa）、热稳定性及抗氧化能力，并赋予其对食源性细菌的抗菌活性（对革兰氏阳性菌效果更强）。含2.0% HEWL的膜用于室温贮藏半干乌鳢，可延缓微生物增殖和脂质氧化，维持产品水分达3天。研究表明明胶胶囊废弃物可增值利用为活性包装基质，用于半干水产品的短期保鲜。

papers.title: Pathways for high-quality development of marine ranching in the Beibu Gulf urban agglomeration
papers.authors: Huang, Jinsui; Wang, Jiannan; Chen, Zhen
papers.abstract: The transition of marine ranching from scale-oriented expansion toward high-quality development requires the simultaneous improvement of production efficiency, ecological sustainability, and farmed-animal welfare. However, increasing stocking intensity and technological investment may generate trade-offs among economic output, ecological carrying capacity, animal health, and long-term production sustainability. Existing studies have mainly examined ecological efficiency, resource and environmental carrying capacity, technological innovation, and industrial performance, while farmed aquatic animal welfare and its systemic interactions with ecological and socioeconomic outcomes remain insufficiently addressed. To fill this gap, this study introduces the One Welfare framework and constructs a One Welfare High-Quality Development Index (OWHI) integrating animal welfare, ecological environment, and economic and social development. Based on marine-ranching policy texts and development practices in the Beibu Gulf urban agglomeration, fuzzy-set Qualitative Comparative Analysis (fsQCA) is employed to identify configurations associated with high-quality development, while System Dynamics (SD) is used to examine feedback mechanisms and the long-term effects of alternative policy combinations. The results reveal substantial conjunctural causation and equifinality, with no single condition constituting a necessary condition for high OWHI. Three major pathways are identified: technology-policy driven, ecology-market synergistic, and welfare-environment synergistic configurations. Smart technological empowerment and animal welfare management play important cross-path roles. Scenario simulations further show that isolated welfare, technological, or ecological interventions generate limited long-term improvements, whereas the coordinated integration of welfare standards, AI-enabled monitoring, IMTA, and cross-regional governance produces stronger and more persistent synergistic effects. These findings extend conventional ecological-economic-social assessments of marine ranching by explicitly incorporating animal welfare and provide a configurational and dynamic basis for improving marine ranching sustainability.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究旨在弥补海洋牧场研究中养殖动物福利维度缺失的不足，引入One Welfare框架构建了整合动物福利、生态环境与经济社会发展的One Welfare高质量发展指数（OWHI）。基于北部湾城市群海洋牧场政策文本与发展实践，采用fsQCA识别高质量发展路径，并运用系统动力学（SD）模拟反馈机制与政策组合的长期效应。结果表明不存在单一必要条件，识别出技术-政策驱动、生态-市场协同、福利-环境协同三条路径，智能技术赋能与动物福利管理具有跨路径重要作用；情景模拟显示孤立干预效果有限，而福利标准、AI监测、IMTA与跨区域治理的协同整合产生更强且持久的协同效应。

papers.title: Beyond landings: seven decades of marine catch reconstruction reveal unreported catches, structural shifts, and reporting gaps in Uruguay
papers.authors: Licandro, Juan A.; Bausero-Jorcin, Sofía; Chocca, Julio; de Álava, Anita; Marín, Yamandú; Defeo, Omar
papers.abstract: Long-term fisheries statistics often underestimate total removals by overlooking small-scale, subsistence, recreational catches, and discards, thereby biasing assessments of fisheries trends and undermining management effectiveness and governance performance. Here, we reconstruct Uruguay’s marine fisheries catches over seven decades (1950-2022), integrating official statistics with expert-based estimates to quantify industrial, small-scale (SSF), subsistence, recreational, and discard components. Reconstructed total catches ranged from 5.0 to 5.14 million tonnes. Industrial fisheries dominated national landings until the mid-2000s, followed by a prolonged decline driven by overexploitation of key species, fleet contraction, and market constraints. In contrast, SSF have gained relative importance since 2007 and now contribute nearly one fifth of total marine landings, reflecting both structural shifts and improved statistical coverage. Subsistence and recreational fisheries remain low in volume but socially and culturally significant, yet largely absent from official datasets. These long-term trends reveal marked changes in species composition, fishing gears, and sectoral contributions, alongside critical data gaps, particularly in industrial discards and early SSF records. By correcting presentist bias and recovering unreported catches, this reconstruction provides a more complete perspective on the historical trajectory and current status of Uruguay’s marine fisheries. The findings highlight the need for more transparent and inclusive monitoring systems embedded within participatory governance frameworks. More broadly, they demonstrate how long-term reconstructions can expose structural transformations and persistent data blind spots in national fisheries, offering a transferable basis for comparative analyses and for strengthening evidence-based governance under chronic data limitation.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究重建了乌拉圭1950–2022年海洋渔业捕捞量，将官方统计与专家估算相结合，量化工业、小规模（SSF）、自给性、休闲渔业及丢弃部分。重建总捕捞量为500–514万吨，工业渔业在2000年代中期前主导上岸量，此后因关键种过度开发、船队收缩和市场制约持续下降；SSF自2007年起相对重要性上升，目前约占总上岸量的五分之一。研究揭示了物种组成、渔具和部门贡献的结构性变化，以及工业丢弃和早期SSF记录等关键数据缺口，强调需建立更透明包容的监测体系并纳入参与式治理框架。

papers.title: Atlantic salmon marine survival and distribution inferred from six decades of scale-derived growth: temporal trends and growth consistency among sea ages
papers.authors: Breau, Cindy; Chaput, Gérald J; Friedland, Kevin D.
papers.journal: Canadian Journal of Fisheries and Aquatic Sciences
papers.abstract: Across its range, the survival and maturation dynamics of Atlantic salmon (Salmo salar) are dependent on growth, energy reserves, and predation pressure. This study examined growth of one-sea-winter (1SW) and two-sea-winter (2SW) salmon using archived scales collected from the Miramichi River, Canada, spanning 59 smolt migration years (1958-2016). Fork length and nearly all scale-derived growth metrics exhibited significant long-term linear trends, however, no evidence was found for critical periods of reduced growth. Hence, growth during the post-smolt year showed no declines corresponding to periods of reduced marine survival, suggesting that variation in marine recruitment of North American Atlantic Salmon are not dependent on post-smolt growth. Growth patterns recorded on scales, including intercirculi spacing, were broadly similar between sea-age groups until the end of the first winter at sea, suggesting shared migration routes and overlapping marine distribution during this period. By identifying temporal shifts in growth and critical phases of growth similarity and divergence, this study improves understanding of salmon responses to environmental variability and refines inferences about the marine distribution of salmon from individual populations.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究利用加拿大Miramichi河1958–2016年共59个smolt迁移年的存档鳞片，分析1SW和2SW大西洋鲑（Salmo salar）的生长长期趋势及海龄间生长一致性。叉长和几乎所有鳞片衍生生长指标均呈显著线性长期趋势，但未发现生长下降的关键时期，表明post-smolt年生长变化与海洋存活率下降不对应，北美大西洋鲑海洋补充量变动不依赖post-smolt生长。两海龄组鳞片生长模式（含intercirculi间距）在海上第一个冬季结束前基本相似，提示该时期共享洄游路线和重叠的海洋分布。

papers.title: Uncovering tiger shark (Galeocerdo cuvier) habitat use in an eastern central Atlantic biodiversity hotspot (Boa Vista Island, Cabo Verde) through a stereo-baited remote underwater video system and local ecological knowledge
papers.authors: Saldanha-da-Gama, João; Vizeu-Pinheiro, Margarida; Varela, Jaquelino; Nunes, Emanuel; Rosa, Rui
papers.abstract: Tiger sharks ( Galeocerdo cuvier ) are apex predators with well-established ecological roles in tropical and subtropical marine ecosystems, yet their spatial ecology in the eastern Atlantic remains almost entirely unresolved. Here we provide the first systematic, comprehensive characterisation of tiger shark habitat use around Boa Vista Island, which hosts one of the Atlantic’s largest loggerhead turtle nesting aggregations, within the Cabo Verde archipelago, a priority area for elasmobranch conservation. To characterise tiger shark habitat use around the island, 526 stereo-baited remote underwater video (stereo-BRUV) deployments across four survey periods in 2025 were combined with 40 local ecological knowledge (LEK) interviews. Tiger sharks occurred on 5.5% of deployments (29 detections), with 86% of detections east of 22.80° W. Detection frequency peaked at 11.6% in June, coinciding with the onset of the loggerhead nesting season, compared with 1.9–2.8% in the remaining survey periods. Detection probability was negatively associated with sea surface temperature and positively associated with salinity, but both covariates varied almost entirely between sampling months, preventing these associations from being distinguished from temporal variation. Measured individuals ranged from 1,487 to 4,502 mm fork length, and 12 of 26 (46%) were juvenile-sized, indicating that multiple size classes use the shelf and that early-life habitat use in the region is a priority for future research. LEK identified a broader perceived occurrence footprint, including Baía de Sal Rei within the coastal survey domain and the offshore João Valente Bank beyond it—both IUCN-designated Important Shark and Ray Areas—as priority areas for targeted future surveys. Together, these findings shift the evidence base for tiger sharks in the eastern Atlantic from simple presence confirmation to the first systematic description of recurrent, seasonally structured habitat use, providing an initial empirical foundation for conservation planning of this apex predator in a data-poor yet ecologically significant region.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究旨在填补东大西洋虎鲨（Galeocerdo cuvier）空间生态学研究的空白，采用526次立体诱饵远程水下视频（stereo-BRUV）调查结合40份当地生态知识（LEK）访谈，首次系统描述佛得角博阿维斯塔岛周边虎鲨的生境利用格局。虎鲨在5.5%的调查站位中被检出（29次），其中86%集中于22.80°W以东水域，6月检出率最高（11.6%），与蠵龟筑巢季开始时间吻合。检出个体叉长为1,487–4,502 mm，其中46%为幼体规格，表明该陆架区为多规格群体共用生境。LEK识别出Sal Rei湾和João Valente浅滩（均为IUCN认定的重要鲨鳐区域）为未来重点调查区域，研究将该区域虎鲨证据基础从单纯的存在确认提升至季节性生境利用的系统描述。

papers.title: Unraveling spatiotemporal heterogeneity of fish assemblages and algal control performance by silver and bighead carps in riverine reservoir ecosystems
papers.authors: Yin, Chengjie; Zhang, Rongzhen; Sun, Yuxin; Feng, Zewen; Shi, Xiaoning; Li, Renhui; Xiang, Miao; Zhang, He; Guo, Longgen
papers.summary_cn: 该研究针对河流型水库生态系统，探讨鲢（silver carp）与鳙（bighead carp）对鱼类群落及藻类控制效果的时空异质性。由于摘要缺失，具体方法未知，推测结合时空采样与群落分析评估放养对藻类的下行控制效应。

papers.title: Conserving Colonial Order: A Review of Laws and Policies for Conserving Pacific Salmon in Canada
papers.authors: Connoy, Jared W. H.; Fisher, Aidan; Newell, Dianne; Ballantyne, Leah; Reid, Andrea J.
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Since its emergence, conservation biology has been framed as a discipline focused on preserving biodiversity. Less often acknowledged is that conservation is shaped by cultural assumptions about how, why, when, where and by and for whom it is designed and applied. Failing to recognize these assumptions risks reinforcing unjust systems of power rooted in historical forces that continue to shape present‐day realities. This is especially evident for Pacific salmon in Canada, where colonial management systems have disenfranchised Indigenous fishers for over a century. In this narrative review, we describe critical moments in this history, focusing on case studies from British Columbia and drawing parallels to the United States and Sápmi to illustrate the pervasiveness of colonialism in salmon fisheries management. We examine periods from pre‐colonial times to the present, focusing on Indigenous fisheries governance, treaty processes, the criminalization and vilification of Indigenous fishers, Indigenous resistance and significant legal and legislative developments. Our analysis shows that states have frequently leveraged conservation needs to justify policies benefiting settler societies while disenfranchising Indigenous communities, legacies that continue to shape power dynamics within contemporary fisheries conservation. We write primarily to settler decision makers, fisheries scientists and managers and the legal community, who play critical roles in reconciliation with Indigenous Peoples. We highlight the need for Indigenous authority over conservation, state institutions directly accountable to Indigenous Peoples, sustained funding for Indigenous‐led salmon restoration and management and the upholding of Indigenous laws as essential steps towards a more just fisheries conservation and governance.
papers.summary_cn: 该综述以加拿大太平洋鲑（Pacific salmon）管理为案例，梳理从殖民前至当代的原住民渔业治理、条约进程、原住民渔民被刑事化与污名化、原住民抵抗及重要立法发展，并与美国和Sápmi地区进行比较。分析表明，国家常以保护需求为由为有利于定居者社会的政策辩护，同时剥夺原住民社区权利，其遗留影响持续塑造当代渔业保护中的权力格局。作者呼吁承认原住民在保护中的权威、建立对原住民直接负责的国家机构、持续资助原住民主导的鲑鱼恢复与管理，并维护原住民法律，以实现更公正的渔业保护与治理。

papers.title: Monsoon, mixing, and nutrient enrichment regulate phytoplankton succession and biogeochemical cycling in the northern South China Sea
papers.authors: Nilajkar, Sujata Kallappa; Ma, Wei; Pujari, Laxman Ashok; Hu, Jianyu; Yang, Jin-Yu; Xu, Yanping; Sun, Jun
papers.summary_cn: 该研究探讨季风、混合与营养盐富集如何调控南海北部浮游植物演替及生物地球化学循环，基于标题推测采用现场观测与物理-生物耦合分析。研究有助于理解季风驱动下南海北部生态系统变动机制。

papers.title: Diverse effects of coastal infrastructure and water column properties on current and future occurrence of gelatinous zooplankton species
papers.authors: Greene, Correigh M; Dominguez, Joshua H; Chamberlin, Joshua W; Hall, Jason E; Rhodes, Linda D
papers.summary_cn: 该研究探讨海岸带基础设施与水柱理化性质对胶质浮游动物（gelatinous zooplankton）物种当前及未来出现格局的多样化影响，基于物种分布数据评估多重环境驱动因子的相对作用。

papers.title: Coupling diet and foraging behavior of a surface-feeding seabird to map prey spatial distribution in the Gulf of Alaska
papers.authors: Depot, Katelyn Marie; Whelan, Shannon; Arimitsu, Mayumi L; Clucas, Gemma V; Elliott, Kyle Hamish
papers.summary_cn: 该研究以阿拉斯加湾一种水面取食海鸟为对象，结合其食性分析与觅食行为观测，旨在推断猎物（鱼类或无脊椎动物）的空间分布格局。由于摘要缺失，具体方法与结果无法获知，但研究思路为利用海鸟作为生态采样器辅助渔业资源空间制图提供了参考。

papers.title: Fish and Shellfish As the Dominant Dietary Sources of Vitamin D Among Japanese Adults: National Surveys (2015-2024)
papers.authors: Omura, Takuya
papers.summary_cn: 基于2015—2024年日本全国调查数据，分析日本成年人维生素D的主要膳食来源，发现鱼类和贝类是其主要摄入来源。

papers.title: Identification and Analysis of Fish Processing and Consumption Characteristics in Restaurants in the Bucharest-Ilfov Area
papers.authors: CRISTEA, Cristian; MARIN, Monica Paula; BAHACIU, Gratziela; POGURSCHI, Elena Narcisa; TOMA, Ionela Florentina; DOBROTĂ, Gheorghe; NICOLAE, Carmen Georgeta
papers.journal: Bulletin of University of Agricultural Sciences and Veterinary Medicine Cluj-Napoca. Animal Science and Biotechnologies
papers.abstract: Fish consumption in restaurants in Romania is a complex phenomenon, influenced by a number of economic, political, cultural and ecological factors. In the context of a growing demand for fish dishes, this report explores the characteristics of the fish processing and consumption market in Romanian restaurants, with a special focus on the Bucharest-Ilfov area. The purpose of this study is to identify and analyse the factors that influence the consumption of fish in restaurants and to provide recommendations for improving menus and increasing sustainability in this sector. The current research was conducted as a survey case analysis within restaurants order to gather quantitative and qualitative data on fish consumption patterns. The results indicate that diversifying menus by introducing more fish dishes can bring significant benefits to restaurants, both economically and operationally. Fish also proves to be a versatile and sustainable raw material, which, if used correctly, can attract new segments of consumers concerned about health and sustainability.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究旨在识别和分析影响布加勒斯特-伊尔福夫地区餐馆鱼类消费的因素，并为进一步优化菜单和提升可持续性提供建议。研究采用问卷调查案例分析法，收集餐馆鱼类消费模式的定量与定性数据。结果表明，通过增加鱼类菜品实现菜单多样化可为餐馆带来显著的经济和运营效益，鱼类作为多功能且可持续的原材料，合理利用可吸引关注健康与可持续性的新消费群体。

papers.title: Uptake, application and impact of an open access platform for investigating global marine fishing activity
papers.authors: Kerry, Chris; Storer, Lauren; Metcalfe, Kristian; Miller, Nathan A.; Nuno, Ana; Sánchez-Tapia, Andrea; Godley, Brendan J.
papers.abstract: Abstract High-resolution datasets can transform understanding and management of human activities in the ocean, yet their real-world uptake and impact remains poorly quantified. Here, we assess the influence of Global Fishing Watch (GFW), an open access platform that monitors fishing activity globally, by combining a user questionnaire ( n = 467) with a structured review of peer-reviewed and grey literature ( n = 293). Questionnaire responses reveal frequent engagement across academia, NGOs and government, with the interactive map and download portal as main access points. Publications, however, are dominated by those from high-income countries, highlighting inequities in data use and publishing barriers. GFW datasets are applied across diverse thematic areas, with ecology, conservation, and monitoring of illegal, unreported and unregulated fishing emerging as dominant foci. Discrepancies between self-reported use and published outputs suggest that publication metrics underestimate the platform’s real-world impact in geographic scope, and areas such as applied policy, teaching and outreach. Despite its open-access nature, persistent barriers limit engagement, particularly in lower-income regions, leading to uneven global uptake. Overall, GFW enhances transparency and supports evidence-based management, targeted capacity-building, broader use of ancillary datasets and systematic tracking of societal outputs are needed to fully realise its potential for equitable ocean governance.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究通过467份用户问卷与293篇同行评议及灰色文献的结构化综述，评估了开放获取平台Global Fishing Watch（GFW）在监测全球捕捞活动中的实际使用与影响。问卷显示学术界、NGO和政府部门使用频繁，主要入口为交互地图与数据下载端口，但发表成果集中于高收入国家，暴露数据使用与发表壁垒的不平等。GFW数据主要应用于生态学、保护及IUU捕捞监测，自报使用与发表产出间的差距表明文献计量低估了其在政策应用、教学与推广等方面的实际影响。尽管平台开放获取，低收入地区仍面临持续使用障碍，全球采纳不均衡，需针对性能力建设与系统性社会产出追踪以支撑公平的海洋治理。

papers.title: Captive breeding and early life history of the near threatened red-finned catopra Pristolepis rubripinnis (Teleostei: Pristolepididae), an endemic fish from the Western Ghats
papers.authors: Varghese, Binu; Thiruvarasu, S.; George, Grace; Al Jalees, Anees; Kumar, Ajeth
papers.summary_cn: 本研究以近危的西高止山脉特有鱼类红鳍锯鳞鲈（Pristolepis rubripinnis）为对象，围绕其人工繁殖与早期生活史开展研究，旨在为该物种的保育提供基础生物学依据。

papers.title: Computer Vision Advances in Monitoring Multi‐Species Invertebrate Fisheries in the Pacific
papers.authors: Shedrawi, George; Magron, Franck; Tiitii, Ulusapeti; Fepuleai, Faasulu; Papalii, Isaako; Mosile, Christina; Aiafi, Justin; Fatongiatau, Viliami; Molai, Chris; Jalam, Shivam
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Monitoring diverse, dispersed small‐scale invertebrate fisheries remains challenging because taxonomic diversity, informal trade and dispersed harvesting limit sustained programs that can capture standardised data used for catch identification and measurement. Computer vision is increasingly being used to overcome these challenges, but most affordable and accessible single‐camera systems face a trade‐off: close‐range imagery required for high fidelity species identification while increasing parallax error for three‐dimensional specimens. We tested a hardware‐agnostic calibration method to improve an automated fisheries‐monitoring platform. Nationally standardised coins placed on specimens provided a local, distance‐independent scale reference. Manual, coin‐corrected and uncorrected computer‐vision measurements of carapace length in spiny lobsters ( Panulirus penicillatus ) were compared using linear mixed‐effects models. Coin correction removed systematic bias, reducing mean percentage error from 10.77% to 1.20% and mean absolute error from 8.6 to 2.3 mm. By contrast, linear‐regression correction for Panulirus penicillatus under‐corrected small lobsters and over‐corrected large individuals, biasing Length‐Based Spawning Potential Ratio estimates. Where remote observers could verify species‐level labels, computer‐vision classification exceeded 90% accuracy, with other performance metrics scoring above 80%. Performance on unfiltered operational data depended on image acquisition: close‐range board imagery substantially outperformed greater‐distance mat imagery for taxa requiring fine diagnostic detail, particularly bivalves and gastropods. Coplanar calibration is therefore necessary for 2D computer‐vision systems to provide reliable species identification and morphometric data simultaneously, supporting scalable, field‐appropriate monitoring of multi‐species invertebrate fisheries in data‐limited small‐island developing states.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究针对太平洋小岛屿发展中国家多物种无脊椎动物小型渔业监测难题，测试了一种硬件无关的校准方法以改进自动渔业监测平台。通过在标本旁放置全国标准化硬币作为局部尺度参照，比较了人工测量、硬币校正和未校正计算机视觉测量对锦绣龙虾（Panulirus penicillatus）头胸甲长度的误差。硬币校正消除了系统偏差，将平均百分比误差从10.77%降至1.20%，平均绝对误差从8.6 mm降至2.3 mm；而线性回归校正会低估小型个体、高估大型个体，导致基于体长的产卵潜力比（Length-Based Spawning Potential Ratio）估算偏倚。在可验证物种标签的条件下，计算机视觉分类准确率超过90%，共面校准对2D计算机视觉系统同时提供可靠物种鉴定和形态测量数据至关重要。

papers.title: Tambaqui ( Colossoma macropomum ) Production in Recirculating Aquaculture Systems ( RAS ): Evidence, Management Requirements and Research Gaps
papers.authors: Luz, Ronald Kennedy; dos Santos, Fabio Aremil Costa; Favero, Gisele Cristina
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Tambaqui ( Colossoma macropomum ) is an important commercial fish species in Latin America and Asia, where its production primarily relies on pond farming and net cage culture. The need for more controlled and sustainable production systems has increased interest in recirculating aquaculture systems (RAS). This narrative review, based on a structured literature search, synthesizes current evidence on tambaqui production in RAS throughout its production cycle. Available studies demonstrate successful production from larviculture and juvenile rearing through fattening and broodstock development, including induced reproduction. The review also examines management practices involving stocking density, temperature, feeding and nutrition, behavioral management, feed restriction, and anesthetics during handling. Evidence is strongest for larviculture and juvenile rearing under controlled experimental conditions, whereas fattening and broodstock production are promising but require further commercial‐scale validation. Despite these advances, further research is needed to validate the available findings across larger and commercial‐scale systems, improve the reporting of engineering and operational parameters, and expand knowledge on carrying capacity, techno‐economic performance, energy demand, long‐term fish welfare, and genetic management. Overall, RAS represents a technically viable and promising strategy for tambaqui production. However, commercial expansion requires system‐specific validation integrating biological performance, fish welfare, engineering efficiency, energy use, and economic viability.
papers.summary_cn: 该综述基于结构化文献检索，系统梳理了 tambaqui（*Colossoma macropomum*）在 RAS 中全生产周期的现有证据，涵盖 larviculture、幼鱼培育、育肥及 broodstock 开发（含诱导繁殖）。管理实践涉及 stocking density、温度、投饲与营养、行为管理、限饲及操作麻醉等。证据在受控实验条件下以 larviculture 和幼鱼阶段最强，育肥与 broodstock 生产具潜力但需商业规模验证；未来需在放大系统验证、工程与运行参数报告、carrying capacity、技术经济性能、能耗、长期福利及遗传管理等方面深化研究。

papers.title: Behavioural Diversity and Ecology of Cleaning Mutualisms in a Changing Ocean
papers.authors: Pereira, B. P.; Rosa, R.; Paula, J. R.
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT One of the most pressing challenges confronting the scientific community today is understanding the consequences of global change on ecological communities and mitigating their impacts. Cleaning mutualisms are essential to the health and stability of coral reef ecosystems, influencing individual fitness, parasite dynamics, and community composition. However, these interactions are increasingly threatened by anthropogenic pressures. This review describes the behavioural diversity and ecology of dedicated cleaners, ranging from cognitively sophisticated wrasses and efficient, low‐conflict gobies to visually signalling shrimps. We then review how the intricate interactions between cleaners and clients respond to environmental change, including chronic stressors (e.g., acidification), extreme events (e.g., marine heatwaves), and direct anthropogenic disturbances (e.g., underwater noise). Mounting evidence demonstrates that such stressors can disrupt cleaner and client dynamics, diminishing interaction motivation and quality, and altering underlying neurobiological mechanisms. Despite recent advances, significant gaps remain in our understanding of the long‐term resilience and recovery of cleaning mutualisms across ecological, behavioural, cognitive and physiological pathways. As ocean climate‐related drivers of change intensify and increasingly co‐occur, it becomes urgent to investigate whether cleaners can continue to fulfil their ecological roles, or if reefs will face a future with compromised mutualistic services.
papers.summary_cn: 该综述聚焦珊瑚礁清洁共生（cleaning mutualism）的行为多样性与生态功能，涵盖裂唇鱼、虾虎鱼及清洁虾等主要清洁者类群，并系统梳理其对酸化、海洋热浪及水下噪声等环境胁迫的响应。现有证据表明，这些胁迫可削弱清洁者与客户鱼的互动动机与质量，并改变其神经生物学机制。作者指出，在多重海洋气候变化因子叠加背景下，清洁共生关系的长期恢复力及其生态服务能否维持仍存在显著认知缺口。

papers.title: Spatial Patterns of Lipid Composition and Trophic Biomarkers in the Argentine Anchovy ( Engraulis anchoita ) Across Contrasting Shelf Environments
papers.authors: Isla‐Naveira, Rocío; Liebana, Clara; Parietti, Manuela; Arruebarrena Di Palma, Andrés; Buratti, Claudio; Macchi, Gustavo; Temperoni, Brenda
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT In continental shelf ecosystems, physical‐biological coupling between hydrographic structures and bottom‐up pathways can generate spatial gradients in prey availability and quality that may influence the lipid quality of small pelagic fish. The income‐breeding Engraulis anchoita on the Northern Argentinean Continental Shelf (NACS) fuels reproduction through active feeding and makes tissue lipid quality closely linked to local oceanographic and dietary conditions. This study integrated stomach content and tissue‐specific fatty acid (FA) analyses sampled in three zones of the NACS spawning ground under contrasting oceanographic conditions: Río de la Plata salinity front (RP), Mar del Plata shelf waters (MDP), and El Rincón thermohaline front (ER) during austral spring. Diet composition differed markedly among sampling zones, shifting from small euryhaline copepods in RP to almost exclusive consumption of the lipid‐rich Calanoides carinatus in ER. These variations were accompanied by differences in tissue FA profiles: ER individuals showed the highest total lipid content, saturated FA, and polyunsaturated FA concentrations, while MDP muscle was dominated by monounsaturated FA, matching Calanidae copepod markers. The omega‐3/omega‐6 was highest in ER ovaries, indicating selective omega‐3 enrichment. The DHA/EPA ratio decreased from RP to ER, reflecting a progressive shift toward diatom‐based food webs at lower temperatures, while the EPA/ARA ratio increased from RP to ER in both tissues, suggesting that individuals inhabiting the productive ER frontal system were in a more advanced reproductive condition. Together, these results reveal spatial patterns in tissue lipid quality closely coupled to the physical heterogeneity of the NACS shelf, suggesting a potential bottom‐up trophic pathway that may have implications upon anchovy egg viability, larval survival and fish conditions.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究旨在探究阿根廷北部大陆架（NACS）不同海洋环境对阿根廷鳀（Engraulis anchoita）组织脂质组成及营养标志物的空间影响。研究整合胃含物与组织特异性脂肪酸分析，在产卵场的三个区域（Río de la Plata 盐度锋、Mar del Plata 陆架水域和 El Rincón 温盐锋）进行采样。结果显示各区域饵料组成差异显著，从 RP 的小型广盐性桡足类转向 ER 几乎专食富含脂质的 Calanoides carinatus，并伴随组织脂肪酸谱的相应变化：ER 个体总脂质、饱和及多不饱和脂肪酸含量最高，ER 卵巢 omega-3/omega-6 比值最高，DHA/EPA 比值从 RP 到 ER 递减而 EPA/ARA 比值递增。这些空间格局与 NACS 陆架物理异质性密切耦合，提示存在自下而上的营养通路，可能影响鳀鱼卵活力、仔鱼存活及鱼体状况。

papers.title: Fish Scale-Derived Collagen for Cosmetic, Nutricosmetic, and Biomedical Applications: Processing, Material Forms, and Evidence
papers.authors: Andriani, Yuli; Pratama, Rusky Intan
papers.abstract: Fish scales are a well-established source of type I collagen and represent a potential route for recovering higher-value materials from fish-processing by-products. However, fish-scale collagen is often treated as a single material even though processing can generate products with markedly different structures, functions, and levels of supporting evidence. This narrative review examines fish-scale-derived collagen across the source-processing-material form-property-application-evidence continuum, with emphasis on cosmetic, nutricosmetic, and biomedical uses. Four material categories are distinguished: purified collagen, collagen peptides or hydrolysates, collagen-containing composites, and retained whole-scale collagenous matrices. Available studies show that fish species, scale composition, demineralization, extraction, hydrolysis, and material modification influence collagen recovery, structural integrity, thermal behavior, fibril formation, and downstream performance. For skin-related applications, several controlled human studies support defined orally administered fish-scale collagen peptide preparations for selected hydration, elasticity, and wrinkle-related outcomes, whereas controlled human evidence for topical application remains limited. Biomedical evidence is most developed for wound-healing materials, while bone, oral, periodontal, and corneal applications have progressed through cell-based and animal studies. Many favorable outcomes, however, involve composite materials or retained scale matrices and cannot be attributed to collagen alone. Translation remains constrained by raw-material heterogeneity, inconsistent extraction and yield reporting, incomplete product-specific safety assessment, sterilization and manufacturing requirements, limited human biomedical evidence, and insufficient environmental and economic evaluation of scale-up. Fish-scale collagen should therefore be considered a family of application-dependent materials rather than a uniform alternative collagen source.
papers.summary_cn: 鱼鳞是I型胶原的成熟来源，可作为鱼品加工副产物高值化利用的途径。本文围绕来源—加工—材料形态—性质—应用—证据链，将鱼鳞胶原分为纯化胶原、胶原肽/水解物、含胶原复合材料和保留完整鱼鳞的胶原基质四类，综述其在化妆品、营养化妆品及生物医学领域的应用证据。研究表明，鱼种、鱼鳞组成、脱矿、提取、水解及材料改性均影响胶原回收率、结构完整性、热行为、纤维形成及下游性能；口服鱼鳞胶原肽对皮肤水合、弹性和皱纹的改善已有若干对照人体研究支持，而外用制剂的对照人体证据仍有限，生物医学证据以伤口愈合材料最为充分。鱼鳞胶原的转化仍受原料异质性、提取与产率报告不规范、产品特异性安全性评估不足、灭菌与生产要求、人体生物医学证据有限及规模化环境经济评价缺乏等制约，应将其视为一类依应用而异的材料家族而非统一的替代胶原来源。

papers.title: Criminal Liability for Fish Shooting Machine Gambling: A Comparative Analysis of Positive Law and Islamic Criminal Law
papers.authors: Laila Hairani; Risalan Basri Harahap; Hendra Gunawan
papers.abstract: Fish shooting machine gambling remains a social and legal problem in Purba Tua Village, Batang Onang Subdistrict, despite its prohibition under Indonesian positive law and Islamic criminal law. This study examines the mechanisms, contributing factors, criminal liability, and applicable sanctions for the practice from both legal perspectives. Employing empirical legal research with a sociological-juridical approach, the study uses descriptive qualitative analysis based on interviews, observations, and documentation. Data were obtained from nine informants representing residents, community leaders, religious leaders, police officers, and players. The findings reveal that players deposit money to obtain game credits, while accumulated points can be exchanged for cash, demonstrating the elements of wagering and financial gain. The practice involves machine owners, operators, venue providers, attendants, and players. Its persistence is associated with expectations of quick profits, peer influence, economic circumstances, and limited compliance with legal and religious prohibitions. Under Law Number 1 of 2023, organizers may be subject to Article 426, while players may be subject to Article 427, depending on their respective roles and the evidence established. From the perspective of Islamic criminal law, the practice constitutes maisir and may be classified as jarimah ta'zir. It also contradicts maqashid al-syari'ah, particularly the protection of wealth, intellect, religion, and family. Effective prevention requires proportionate law enforcement, legal education, religious guidance, and community involvement.
papers.summary_cn: 该研究考察印尼Purba Tua村捕鱼机赌博活动的运作机制、成因、刑事责任及适用处罚，采用经验性法律研究与社会学-法学方法，通过访谈、观察和文献资料进行定性分析。研究发现玩家通过充值获取游戏积分并兑换现金，具备赌博与营利要素，涉及机主、经营者、场地提供者、服务员和玩家等多方主体。依印尼2023年第1号法律，组织者可能适用第426条、玩家可能适用第427条；从伊斯兰刑法角度该行为构成maisir并可归为jarimah ta'zir，违背maqashid al-syari'ah。有效防治需比例执法、法律教育、宗教引导与社区参与相结合。

papers.title: Redescription of the marbled stargazer Uranoscopus marmoratus Cuvier, 1829 (Labriformes, Uranoscopidae)
papers.authors: Ponnappan, Anjana; Vijayan, Aneesh Kumar Kannamkulathil; Nihal, Davood; Kinattumkara, Bineesh; Fricke, Ronald
papers.abstract: Abstract The Marbled Stargazer, Uranoscopus marmoratus, is redescribed based on five individuals collected from the southeastern Arabian Sea, India. This species is a poorly known fish which is distributed predominantly in the eastern Indian Ocean and belongs to the Uranoscopus japonicus species group. U. marmoratus is defined as having one pair of basipterygial processes; a simple posterior nostril and tubular anterior nostril; one internal supracleithral spine and one sharp humeral spine; 4–5 preopercular and 1 subopercular spines; no scales on the predorsal region; no supraocular cirri; 52–62 transverse rows of scales on the sides of the body; well‐developed occipital lobes; occipital commissure with four posterior branches; head length 2.6–3.6 times in standard length; head large; head width 3.0–3.3 times in standard length; body depth 4.2–4.7 times in standard length; head depth 1.1–1.4 times its width; dorsal surface marbled, with pale spots on a brown background. Otolith morphological description of the fish was also provided for the first time. COI sequence generated herein represents the first genetic record of the species in GenBank, and Maximum‐Likelihood (K2P) analysis recovered this species as a distinct lineage, offering additional support for its taxonomic distinctiveness.
papers.summary_cn: 基于印度东南阿拉伯海5尾标本对大理石瞻星鱼（Uranoscopus marmoratus）进行了再描述，该种隶属Uranoscopus japonicus种组，此前认知匮乏。研究明确了其鉴别特征（如一对基翼突、无前背鳞、52–62列侧鳞等），首次提供耳石形态描述，并生成COI序列作为GenBank首个遗传记录，ML分析支持其独立分类地位。

papers.title: Evaluating the sustainability of shrimp aquaculture in Vietnam: stakeholder perceptions across production intensification systems
papers.authors: Ngoc, Pham Thi Anh; Phan, Chung Thanh; Mai, Tien Dang; Hoang, Tung; Nguyen, Thai Binh; van den Burg, Sander; Mai, Kien Trung
papers.journal: Journal of Agribusiness in Developing and Emerging Economies
papers.abstract: Purpose This study examines stakeholder perceptions of the importance of 21 sustainability themes across 4 Vietnamese shrimp farming systems. It also assesses associations between respondent characteristics and a separate ranking of perceived system sustainability. Design/methodology/approach Using the Sustainability Assessment of Food and Agriculture Systems (SAFA) Guidelines, 94 respondents each rated 21 themes across 4 systems, yielding 84 ordinal ratings per respondent. Questionnaires were administered in person to 56 respondents and completed online by 38. Theme-specific Friedman tests accounted for repeated observations, with Benjamini-Hochberg adjustment across 21 omnibus tests and, separately, 126 paired Wilcoxon comparisons. Cumulative-link mixed models provided an ordinal sensitivity analysis. Ridge-penalised multinomial regression examined the separate ranking outcome. Findings Differences across systems were supported for 18 of the 21 themes after adjustment for multiple testing. Corporate ethics, rule of law and biodiversity showed no supported omnibus differences. Super-intensive farming generally received the highest ratings for the importance of addressing sustainability issues. These ratings concern perceived priorities rather than measured performance. First-rank counts were 27, 7, 5 and 55 for super-intensive, intensive, semi-intensive and extensive/improved extensive/integrated systems, respectively. Age and self-reported knowledge were positively associated with selected ranking contrasts. These associations provide secondary evidence because two outcome categories were small. Research limitations/implications The purposive sample comprised 52 consumers, 36 business stakeholders and 6 experts. Its size and composition limit generalisation. Survey mode, fixed question order, unmeasured familiarity with production systems, concentrated high ratings and seven uniform response profiles may have influenced the findings. Sparse ranking categories limit prediction and practical interpretation of the multinomial model. Social implications Promoting sustainable shrimp farming systems also aligns with MARD’s approved “Sustainable aquaculture development plan in the Mekong Delta to 2030” (Decision No. 3550/QÐ-BNN-TCTS, August 2021), which aims to develop regional aquaculture sustainably. Originality/value The study applies the SAFA themes to comparisons of shrimp farming systems rated by the same stakeholders. By distinguishing the importance assigned to individual issues from an overall sustainability ranking, it explains how these two forms of judgement contribute different evidence to sustainability assessment.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究基于SAFA指南，调查越南4种对虾养殖系统（超集约、集约、半集约、粗放/改良粗放/综合）中94名利益相关者对21项可持续发展主题的感知重要性及系统可持续性排名。经多重检验校正后，21项主题中有18项在不同系统间存在显著差异，超集约养殖在多数可持续议题的重要性评分上最高。首选排名计数显示超集约系统获55票，远高于其他系统；年龄和自我报告知识水平与部分排名对比相关。研究强调上述评分反映的是感知优先级而非实测绩效，样本的目的性构成限制了结果的普适性。

papers.title: Heterogeneity in carbon emission efficiency across global marine capture fisheries: a metafrontier analysis of technology gaps and reduction potentials
papers.authors: Li, Yan; Zhang, Yimeng; Guo, Bing; Han, Qiaoxia
papers.abstract: Improving the carbon emission efficiency of marine capture fisheries is important for the sustainable development of fisheries under climate change. Using 66 major marine fishing countries over 1995–2017 as the sample, we divided the countries into three groups by fishing structure: high-input predatory fish-dominated, mixed, and small pelagic and other finfish-dominated. We measured carbon emission efficiency with a slacks-based measure (SBM) model with undesirable outputs and a metafrontier approach, and decomposed the potential emission reduction into managerial inefficiency and the technology gap. The results show the following. (1) Carbon emission efficiency was generally low, with a mean metafrontier efficiency of 0.331, and the differences between groups were closely related to catch value. (2) The technology gap was concentrated in the high-input predatory fish-dominated group and the small pelagic and other finfish-dominated group, and its causes differed across countries: in Vietnam, Thailand and Malaysia it was associated with fuel-intensive fishing operations, whereas in Peru and Chile it stemmed from the low value of the catch. (3) The mean annual potential carbon emission reduction of the sample countries was 85.4 Mt CO 2 -eq, about 53% of their total emissions, and was concentrated in countries such as Indonesia, India and Vietnam. (4) Managerial inefficiency was the main source of the reduction potential, accounting for 69%. In the mixed group, almost all of the potential came from managerial inefficiency; in the high-input predatory fish-dominated group, the technology gap dominated; and in the small pelagic and other finfish-dominated group, both sources contributed. Countries should therefore choose different pathways according to the source of their reduction potential. For most countries, catching up with the best practice of similar countries could release most of the potential with existing technology, especially in countries where the potential is concentrated, such as Indonesia and India. Countries whose technology gap is accompanied by high fuel intensity should focus on promoting energy-saving fishing gear and propulsion technology, while countries that mainly land low-value catch should increase the value of their catch.
papers.summary_cn: 研究基于1995—2017年66个主要海洋捕捞国家，按捕捞结构分为高投入掠食性鱼类主导型、混合型和小型中上层及其他鱼类主导型三组，采用含非期望产出的SBM模型与metafrontier方法测算碳排放效率，并将减排潜力分解为管理无效率与技术差距。结果显示，metafrontier平均效率仅0.331，技术差距集中于高投入掠食性鱼类组和小型中上层鱼类组，成因因国而异（如越南、泰国、马来西亚与燃油密集型作业相关，秘鲁、智利则源于渔获价值低）。样本国年均减排潜力约85.4 Mt CO2-eq（约占排放总量的53%），主要集中于印度尼西亚、印度、越南等国，其中管理无效率贡献69%。研究建议各国依据减排潜力来源选择差异化路径：多数国家可通过追赶同类最佳实践释放大部分潜力，高燃油强度国家应推广节能渔具与推进技术，低值渔获国家则应提升渔获价值。

papers.title: Portfolio theory is not applicable to fisheries management
papers.authors: Hart, Deborah R.
papers.journal: Canadian Journal of Fisheries and Aquatic Sciences
papers.abstract: There has been considerable recent interest in applying portfolio theory to manage multispecies fisheries, analogous to the management of financial portfolios. It is demonstrated here that this analogy breaks down for several reasons. First, fisheries portfolio theory focuses on mitigating the uncertainty in short-term landings and revenue, which, unlike financial stocks, can usually be predicted to good precision. Meanwhile, it neglects the much more important risks of overfishing and stock depletion. Additionally, while portfolio theory reduces the volatility of the combined portfolio, it may call for highly varying landings of individual fisheries, which can cause considerable hardship. Finally, the control parameters (portfolio weightings) and random variables fundamental to portfolio theory have not been properly defined in the fisheries context, nor do such appropriate definitions seem to exist. Fisheries portfolio theory fails because it focuses on the wrong risk and it calculates this risk incorrectly. Additionally, it is based on an incorrect assumption that the actions of managers do not affect future fishery productivity.
papers.summary_cn: 该文论证金融组合理论不适用于多物种渔业管理。作者指出渔业组合理论聚焦于短期产量与收入的不确定性，而这一不确定性通常可被精确预测，却忽视了过度捕捞与种群衰竭等更重要的风险；组合理论虽能降低整体波动性，却可能导致单个渔业产量剧烈变化，造成经营困难。此外，组合权重等控制参数与随机变量在渔业情境下缺乏恰当定义，且该理论错误假设管理者行为不影响未来渔业生产力。

papers.title: Biological Hazards in Fish Production: Legionella in Aquaculture and Fisheries: A Potential Occupational Exposure?
papers.authors: Cortés-Sánchez, Alejandro De Jesús; Díaz-Ramírez, Mayra; León-Espinosa, Erika Berenice; García-Hernández, Alitzel Belem; Hernández-Nava, Rocío Guadalupe; García-Barrientos, Raquel
papers.abstract: The increasing global demand for fish and fishery products has established fisheries and aquaculture as essential sectors for food security and economic development. However, the intensification of these activities may also increase exposure to biological hazards inherent to aquatic environments and production systems, raising concerns for food safety, occupational and public health. Among these hazards, pathogenic bacteria, associated with water, sediments, and aquatic organisms, are of particular concern. Environmental changes, including climate change and the expansion of aquaculture practices, may further promote the emergence and dissemination of these microorganisms. Within this context, Legionella spp. is recognized as a relevant waterborne pathogen due to its widespread occurrence in natural and artificial aquatic environments and its capacity to cause human disease, primarily through the inhalation of contaminated aerosols. Consequently, workers involved in aquaculture, fisheries, and fish-processing industries may represent a population potentially exposed to this microorganism. Although legionellosis is not considered a zoonosis associated with fish consumption, and no occupational cases linked to these sectors have been reported to date, the persistence of Legionella in aquatic environments highlights a plausible but insufficiently investigated exposure pathway. This narrative review synthesizes information from SciELO, Scopus, Google Scholar, and other relevant bibliographic sources on the biological and clinical characteristics of Legionella, available detection methods and prevention strategies. The aim is to examine the potential for occupational exposure within fish production systems and discuss its possible implications for worker health. By identifying hypothetical exposure scenarios and current knowledge gaps, this review seeks to support future research and contribute to the prevention and assessment of biological risks in the fisheries and aquaculture sectors, without assuming the existence of a demonstrated occupational hazard or an emerging public health problem.
papers.summary_cn: 全球鱼类需求增长使渔业与水产养殖成为粮食安全和经济发展的关键部门，但集约化可能增加从业者对水生环境中生物危害的暴露风险。本文为叙述性综述，综合SciELO、Scopus、Google Scholar等来源文献，聚焦Legionella spp.的生物学与临床特征、检测方法及防控策略，探讨其在鱼类生产系统中的潜在职业暴露途径。尽管目前尚无人鱼消费相关人畜共患病或该行业职业性军团菌病病例报告，Legionella在水生环境中的持续存在提示了一条合理但研究不足的暴露路径，需未来研究加以验证并支撑生物风险评估。

papers.title: Spatial Variation in Fish Assemblages and Their Relationships with Environmental Factors in a Dendritic River Network: The Shimian Reach of the Dadu River, China
papers.authors: Ban, Wenzhuo; Wang, Guowu; Wei, Wenyan; Fu, Suxing; Wang, Yufeng; Qu, Lianshi; Li, Shasha; Zhang, Shilin; Zhang, Yangjun; Yang, Song
papers.abstract: Mountain river networks are composed of a mainstem and multiple tributaries, where complex hydrological processes and habitat heterogeneity provide diverse niches for fishes. Previous studies have documented the fish fauna and diversity in the Dadu River basin, providing baseline information for regional fish conservation. However, differences in fish assemblage composition among river units and their relationships with water environmental conditions require further examination through continuous multi-year surveys. From 2023 to 2025, a three-year continuous survey of fish assemblages was conducted across 28 sampling sites in the mainstem and nine major tributaries of the Shimian reach in the middle Dadu River (upper Yangtze River basin), along with concurrent monitoring of water physicochemical parameters. A total of 54 fish species belonging to three orders and seven families were recorded, with Cyprinidae and Cobitidae being the dominant groups. Fish assemblages were mainly composed of rheophilic, benthic, and demersal-spawning species, reflecting the typical ecological characteristics of fishes in high-gradient river habitats. Fish assemblage composition remained generally stable over the three survey years but showed marked spatial differences among river units. NMDS ordination and PERMANOVA indicated that functional habitat types (mainstem, upstream and confluences) explained a significant proportion of variation in assemblage structure, whereas the effect of survey year was not significant, indicating that spatial differences across habitat types were more pronounced than interannual variation. Distinct fish assemblages were formed among the mainstem, confluences, and individual tributaries, with several natural tributaries supporting higher proportions of endemic and cold-water fishes. Water environmental analyses revealed evident hydrochemical gradients among river units, and redundancy analysis (RDA) showed that water temperature, dissolved oxygen, and nutrient concentrations were closely associated with the spatial distribution of fish assemblages. Building on previous surveys of fish fauna in the Dadu River basin, this study adds three years of fish assemblage data at the mainstem–tributary river network scale and further describes spatial differences in assemblage composition among river units and their relationships with water environmental conditions. These results provide baseline information for understanding the spatial distribution of fish assemblages in alpine canyon rivers and for fish biodiversity conservation and tributary habitat management in the Dadu River basin.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究于2023—2025年对金沙江上游大渡河中游石棉江段干流及9条主要支流共28个采样点开展连续三年鱼类群落调查，同步监测水体理化因子。共记录鱼类54种，隶属3目7科，以鲤科和鳅科为主，群落以喜流水、底栖和底层产卵类型为特征。NMDS排序和PERMANOVA表明，功能栖息地类型（干流、上游及汇口）显著解释群落结构变异，而调查年份影响不显著，说明空间差异强于年际变化；水温、溶解氧和营养盐浓度与鱼类群落空间分布密切相关（RDA）。研究揭示高山峡谷河网鱼类群落的空间格局及其环境驱动因子，为大渡河流域鱼类多样性保护与支流栖息地管理提供基础资料。
