papers.title: Assessment of post-harvest fish loss in Somali fish markets: drivers, impacts, and mitigation strategies
papers.authors: Hashi, Sakariye Ahmed; Dhore, Khalid Omar; Mohamed, Mohamed Abdi
papers.abstract: Introduction Post-harvest fish loss is an important concern in Somalia's fisheries sector, with potential implications for fish quality, livelihoods, food security, and market development. Methods A descriptive, cross-sectional mixed-methods survey was conducted with 94 fisheries stakeholders across four Somali fish markets: Mogadishu, Kismayo, Bosaso, and Berbera. Data were collected through questionnaires, semi-structured interviews, and field observations and analysed using descriptive statistics and thematic analysis. Results Respondents identified inadequate fish handling, limited preservation and cold-storage facilities, unreliable electricity, transportation difficulties, and weaknesses in quality control and enforcement as major challenges. They reported perceived effects on fish availability, market prices, consumer access, food security, income, business activities, and fish quality. Recommended mitigation measures included improved fish handling, timely icing, better cold-chain facilities, improved preservation technologies, training, stronger quality-control systems, and collaboration among stakeholders. Discussion The findings provide insights into stakeholder-perceived post-harvest challenges and potential mitigation strategies in Somali fisheries. However, the study did not directly measure physical fish losses, discarded quantities, or their economic value. The findings therefore represent stakeholder perceptions and reported experiences rather than measured losses or established causal effects.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究旨在评估索马里四个鱼市场（摩加迪沙、基斯马尤、博萨索和柏培拉）的捕捞后损失驱动因素、影响及缓解策略，采用描述性横断面混合方法调查了94名渔业利益相关者。结果显示，主要挑战包括鱼品处理不当、保鲜与冷藏设施不足、电力不稳定、运输困难以及质量控制与执法薄弱，并 perceived 影响鱼品供应、市场价格、消费者获取、粮食安全、收入和鱼品质量。建议的缓解措施包括改善处理、及时加冰、完善冷链设施、改进保鲜技术、培训及加强利益相关者协作；但研究仅反映利益相关者感知，未直接测定实际物理损失或经济价值。

papers.title: Seismic surveying noise has species-specific effects on two commercial fish, Greenland halibut (Reinhardtius hippoglossoides) and witch flounder (Glyptocephalus cynoglossus), as shown using deepwater acoustic telemetry
papers.authors: Geissinger, Emilie A; Nguyen, Khanh; Wheeland, Laura J; Novaczek, Emilie; Cote, David; Borys, Pablo; Morris, Corey J
papers.journal: Canadian Journal of Fisheries and Aquatic Sciences
papers.abstract: Greenland halibut (Reinhardtius hippoglossoides) and witch flounder (Glyptocephalus cynoglossus) are fished in deep water (>500m) along the continental slope of eastern Canada, which is an area of oil and gas exploration. Virtually no information is available regarding the effects of noise on these species at this depth, however, some commercial fish harvesters believe that noise from seismic surveying displaces fish and causes reductions in catch. We used acoustic telemetry and a control-impact study design to test this hypothesis by measuring fish movement in response to weeks of industrial seismic survey noise. There were no large-scale displacements of tracked fish from the impacted area for either species. Greenland halibut movement, while in the study arrays, did not change with proximity to seismic activity. Witch flounder remained in the impact array longer than the control array and were more likely to remain stationary with increased seismic noise. Noise impact in this study revealed different behavioral effects, even within these two flatfish species, and suggests that effects on commercial catch rates will vary according to species.
papers.summary_cn: 研究利用声学遥测（acoustic telemetry）和对照-影响设计，评估工业地震勘探噪声对格陵兰大比目鱼（Reinhardtius hippoglossoides）和女巫鲽（Glyptocephalus cynoglossus）两种商业鱼类移动行为的影响。结果显示两种鱼均未出现从受影响区域的大规模位移；格陵兰大比目鱼的移动与地震活动距离无关，而女巫鲽在影响阵列中停留时间更长，且随噪声增强更倾向于静止不动。研究表明地震噪声的行为效应具有物种特异性，对商业捕捞率的影响将因物种而异。

papers.title: Engineering of Copper-Doped Zinc Oxide Nanoparticles: Unlocking Synergistic Antibacterial Mechanisms and Biofilm Eradication for Sustainable Aquaculture
papers.authors: Wang, Tao; Wan, Jiaqi; Liu, Lijia; Liu, Wei; Wu, Ning
papers.abstract: The overuse of antibiotics in aquaculture has accelerated the emergence of drug-resistant bacteria and biofilm-associated infections, creating an urgent need for alternative antimicrobial agents. Zinc oxide nanoparticles (ZnO NPs) are promising candidates owing to their low toxicity and cost, but their intrinsic antibacterial activity is often inadequate. Herein, we report a series of copper-doped ZnO nanoparticles (Cu@ZnO NPs, 1–5 mol% Cu) synthesized via a facile solvothermal method. The 2% Cu@ZnO NPs, comprising well-dispersed spherical particles of approximately 200 nm with a highly positive surface charge (+20 mV), exhibited the strongest antibacterial activity, outperforming pristine and commercial ZnO, with a minimum inhibitory concentration (MIC) of 0.2 mg/mL and a minimum bactericidal concentration (MBC) of 1.0 mg/mL against both Escherichia coli and Staphylococcus aureus. Mechanistic studies suggested that bactericidal activity may arise from the synergy of electrostatic adsorption, membrane disruption accompanied by protein leakage, intracellular reactive oxygen species (ROS) generation, and sustained metal-ion release. The nanoparticles were shown to reduce biofilm formation by 80.96% and maintained 88.4% viability of L929 fibroblasts at 20 μg/mL, indicating good biocompatibility. In a zebrafish larvae infection model, 5.0 μg/mL of 2% Cu@ZnO increased the 72 h survival rate from 6.25% (Vibrio-challenged) to 65.0%. Cu@ZnO-loaded filter materials further demonstrated practical applicability for aquaculture water pretreatment. This work elucidates the structure–activity relationship of Cu-doped ZnO nanomaterials and offers a low-toxicity, filter-integrable alternative to antibiotics for sustainable aquaculture.
papers.summary_cn: 针对水产养殖中抗生素滥用导致的耐药菌和生物膜感染问题，采用溶剂热法合成1–5 mol%铜掺杂ZnO纳米颗粒（Cu@ZnO NPs），其中2% Cu@ZnO（约200 nm球形颗粒，表面电荷+20 mV）对大肠杆菌和金黄色葡萄球菌抗菌活性最强（MIC 0.2 mg/mL，MBC 1.0 mg/mL），杀菌机制涉及静电吸附、膜破坏与蛋白泄漏、胞内ROS生成及金属离子缓释的协同作用。该纳米颗粒可抑制生物膜形成达80.96%，在20 μg/mL下对L929成纤维细胞保持88.4%存活率，斑马鱼幼鱼感染模型中5.0 μg/mL使72 h存活率从6.25%提升至65.0%。载Cu@ZnO滤材展示了养殖水预处理的实用潜力，为可持续水产养殖提供了低毒、可集成过滤的抗生素替代方案。

papers.title: Quantifying Land-based and Aquaculture-Derived Pollutant Loads in Xuan Dai Bay, Vietnam: A Source-based Assessment for Sustainable Aquaculture
papers.authors: Minh-Thu, Phan; Hung, Nguyen Van; Nhu, Le Thi Hai; Ha, Tran Thanh; Thao, Vu Thi Phuong; Anh, Vu Tuan; Linh, Bui Duc; Mien, Pham Thi
papers.journal: Asian Journal of Fisheries and Aquatic Research
papers.abstract: Coastal water quality is affected by multiple pollution sources, and their contributions to receiving waters depend on pollutant generation, transport pathways, and delivery processes. This study developed a source-based assessment of pollutant loads in the Xuan Dai Bay area, Vietnam, using 2025 activity data for aquaculture, domestic wastewater, crop cultivation, livestock farming, and stormwater runoff. Annual loads of biochemical oxygen demand (BOD), chemical oxygen demand (COD), total nitrogen (TN) and total phosphorus (TP) were estimated using source-specific emission factors and delivery coefficients. Total generated loads were estimated at 3,945.54 tonnes per year (t yr⁻¹) of BOD, 10,711.35 t yr⁻¹ of COD, 1,447.66 t yr⁻¹ of TN, and 318.95 t yr⁻¹ of TP. After the proposed delivery factors were applied, the estimated loads reaching the bay were 1,577.79, 3,955.95, 716.31 and 193.73 t yr⁻¹, respectively. Aquaculture was the dominant source of estimated delivered TN and TP, contributing 70.44% and 82.12%, respectively, while livestock farming was an important source of organic loads. The results demonstrate that source rankings can change when pollutant transport is considered alongside generation. Although the estimates provide an initial basis for prioritizing pollution-control measures, uncertainty in emission factors and delivery coefficients limits their precision. Local validation and hydrodynamic assessment are needed to refine source attribution and support future assessments of environmental carrying capacity.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究基于2025年活动数据，采用源特异性排放因子和输移系数，估算越南Xuan Dai Bay区域水产养殖、生活污水、种植业、畜禽养殖和暴雨径流产生的BOD、COD、TN和TP年负荷。结果表明，经输移系数修正后进入海湾的TN和TP负荷分别为716.31和193.73 t yr⁻¹，水产养殖是TN（70.44%）和TP（82.12%）的主要来源，畜禽养殖则是有机负荷的重要来源。研究强调考虑污染物输移过程后污染源排序可能改变，但排放因子和输移系数的不确定性限制了估算精度，需通过本地验证和水动力评估完善源解析并支撑环境承载力评估。

papers.summary_cn: 该研究聚焦太平洋牡蛎（Crassostrea gigas）整合素（integrin）家族，从基因组组织、系统发育保守性及表达分化三方面解析其功能特征。基于标题推测，研究通过比较基因组学与表达谱分析，揭示整合素家族成员在生长调控与环境适应中的潜在作用。

papers.title: Impacts of the Boreal Summer Intraseasonal Oscillation on marine heatwaves in the Taiwan Strait
papers.authors: Li, Shihan; Qiu, Yun; Lin, Xinyu; Hu, Shijian; Shen, Junqiang; Zhang, Ying
papers.abstract: The Taiwan Strait is a hotspot for frequent and intense marine heatwaves (MHWs) in summer, with severe impacts on local marine ecosystems, yet their underlying mechanisms remain elusive. Recent studies have documented the drivers of MHWs from interannual timescales to long-term changes, while the role of intraseasonal variability is still underexplored. The Boreal Summer Intraseasonal Oscillation (BSISO) is a prominent component of the atmospheric intraseasonal oscillation (ISO) over the tropical Indo-Pacific Ocean. Here, we examine the modulation of BSISO on MHW features over the Taiwan Strait in June–August during 1993–2024, and explore the BSISO-associated local physical processes responsible for each regional MHW. Sea surface temperature and probability of MHW occurrence in the Taiwan Strait fluctuate as the BSISO convection propagates, with the most pronounced increase during phases 4 + 5. Statistical analysis reveals that 52% of regional MHWs coincide with these specific phases, with longer duration and greater cumulative intensity than other events. These regional MHWs are primarily induced by enhanced solar radiation under clear-sky conditions during BSISO phases 4 + 5. Composite heat budget results indicate that intraseasonal shortwave radiation changes contribute approximately 58% of the mixed layer warming tendency and facilitate the genesis and intensification of MHWs. The findings on the physical processes linking the BSISO to MHWs may provide insights into the mechanisms of MHWs from an intraseasonal perspective.
papers.summary_cn: 基于1993–2024年6–8月数据，研究了BSISO对台湾海峡marine heatwaves（MHWs）的调制作用及其局地物理过程。结果表明，台湾海峡SST和MHW发生概率随BSISO对流传播而波动，在位相4+5期间显著升高，52%的区域MHWs与该位相重合且持续时间更长、累积强度更大。晴空条件下增强的短波辐射是主要驱动因素，其贡献了约58%的混合层增温趋势，促进MHWs的生成与增强。

papers.title: A 1951–1998 Lutao coral Pb isotope record reveals site-specific, marine-integrated anthropogenic Pb pollution signals in the Northwest Pacific
papers.authors: Lien, Ming-Yu; Wang, Bo-Shian; You, Chen-Feng
papers.abstract: Coral lead (Pb) isotope records provide multi-decadal perspectives on marine Pb histories, but how individual records represent regional isotope histories remains an important interpretive question. We present a 1951–1998 Pb isotope record from a Porites coral at Lutao, southeast of Taiwan, and compare it with published records from Dongsha and Ogasawara in the Northwest Pacific. The three coral records exhibited substantial inter-site isotopic differences during 1953–1963, smaller differences in interval-mean 208 Pb/ 207 Pb during 1964–1984, and persistent site-specific characteristics. In 1985–1998, Lutao had a statistically distinguishable lower 208 Pb/ 207 Pb composition than Dongsha, whereas the middle-to-late change within Lutao itself was not statistically resolved. This contrast shows that inter-site isotopic differences need not imply an equivalent temporal shift at an individual site. Published Pb isotope reference fields are compatible with multiple possible source combinations but do not uniquely identify historical sources or marine transport mechanisms. Together, these results reveal spatial heterogeneity in coral Pb isotope histories, with smaller inter-site differences during 1964–1984, and highlight the need to evaluate the spatial representativeness of individual coral Pb isotope records before extrapolating site-specific signatures to regional historical interpretations.
papers.summary_cn: 基于台湾绿岛Porites珊瑚的1951–1998年Pb同位素记录，并与东沙及小笠原已发表记录对比，探讨单个珊瑚记录对西北太平洋区域Pb同位素历史的代表性。三站点在1953–1963年同位素差异显著，1964–1984年208Pb/207Pb区间均值差异缩小，但各站点始终保持位点特异性；1985–1998年绿岛208Pb/207Pb显著低于东沙，而绿岛自身中晚期变化未达统计显著。结果表明珊瑚Pb同位素历史存在空间异质性，将位点特异性信号外推至区域历史解释前需评估单条记录的空间代表性。

papers.title: Contributions of the BioMar-ACG Project to the exploration and cataloging of marine macroalgae in the North Pacific of Costa Rica
papers.authors: Fernández-García, Cindy; Monge, Kenneth; Viales-Cubillo, Mariana; González, Kaylen
papers.abstract: Introduction: Costa Rica hosts remarkable marine biodiversity, vital for conserving its marine and coastal ecosystems. However, marine macroalgae remains understudied, especially in the Área de Conservación Guanacaste (ACG). To address this, the BioMar-ACG Project began in 2015 as a collaboration between the government, academic institutions, and NGOs, aiming to document marine biodiversity using morphological and molecular tools, with local community involvement. The project has since expanded macroalgal collections, identified new species, corrected misidentifications, and revealed high regional endemism. Objective: To update the marine macroalgae inventory of the ACG using 2009-2024 collections from the BioMar-ACG Project and CIMAR-UCR previous projects, through morphological and molecular identification. Methods: Surveys were conducted at 35 coastal and island sites, from intertidal zones to 20 m depth, using snorkeling and SCUBA techniques. Sampling occurred during both upwelling and non-upwelling seasons to capture environmental variability. Macroalgae were manually collected, documented in situ, and preserved for morphological and molecular analyses. DNA was extracted using commercial kits, targeting six molecular markers (COX, ITS, psbA, rbcL, tufA, and UPA) for genetic identification. Final taxonomic identifications integrated molecular and morphological data. Results: A total of 562 specimens were analyzed, representing 101 species distributed among Rhodophyta (59 spp.), Heterokontophyta (22 spp.), and Chlorophyta (20 spp.). Thirty-one species were newly recorded for Costa Rica, 22 for the Pacific of Central America, and nine genera were documented for the first time in the region. Molecular analyses revealed nine potential new species to science. Conclusions: The BioMar-ACG Project substantially increased knowledge of the marine flora of Costa Rica’s northern Pacific, doubling the number of species previously reported for the ACG. The discovery of new genera and species, together with high genetic divergence within groups such as Ceramiales and Dictyotales, highlights the underestimated and cryptic nature of macroalgal diversity in the Eastern Tropical Pacific. These findings emphasize the need for continuous exploration, molecular re-evaluation of historical records, and inclusion of diverse habitats and depth gradients in future studies. The integration of morphological and molecular data, combined with community-based research, has proven an effective model for strengthening biodiversity documentation and marine conservation in Costa Rica.
papers.summary_cn: BioMar-ACG项目（2015年启动）采用形态学与分子鉴定相结合的方法，对哥斯达黎加北太平洋ACG保护区的海藻多样性进行了系统调查。研究在35个沿岸及岛屿站点（潮间带至20 m深度）采集了562份标本，基于6个分子标记（COX、ITS、psbA、rbcL、tufA、UPA）鉴定出101种海藻（红藻59种、异鞭藻22种、绿藻20种），其中31种为哥斯达黎加新记录、22种为中美洲太平洋新记录、9个属为区域首次记录，并发现9个潜在科学新种。该项目使ACG已知海藻物种数较此前记录翻倍，揭示出东热带太平洋海藻多样性被严重低估且存在大量隐存种，强调持续开展分子再评估及涵盖多样生境与深度梯度的调查对海洋生物多样性保护的必要性。

papers.title: Relationship between prey visibility and prey ingestion under ultraviolet-A illumination in larval red sea bream Pagrus major

papers.summary_cn: 研究以真鲷（Pagrus major）仔鱼为对象，探讨紫外A（UVA）光照下饵料生物可见性与摄食量的关系。基于标题推测，实验通过改变UVA照射条件评估仔鱼对饵料的摄食响应，以明确UVA视觉在早期摄食行为中的作用。

papers.title: Phosphatidylcholine molecular profiles across fish species: associations with swimming lifestyle and muscle type
papers.authors: Nakashima, Sango; Sato, Tomoki; Mochizuki, Mamiko; Miyoshi, Noriyuki; Miura, Shinji
papers.abstract: Abstract Fish are dietary sources of bioactive lipids, including long-chain n-3 polyunsaturated fatty acids; however, phosphatidylcholine (PC) molecular profiles across fish species and muscle types remain poorly characterized. We analyzed PC molecular species in skeletal muscle from eight fish species by LC-MS-based lipidomics and examined associations with swimming lifestyle and muscle type. PC fatty acyl composition and molecular profiles varied substantially among species, and principal component analysis separated three farmed species from five wild-caught marine species. An exploratory comparison among wild-caught species suggested that the two migratory Scomber species generally showed higher relative abundances of 18:0-, 20:4-, and 22:6-containing PC molecular species than the two demersal species. PC profiles also differed between white and red muscle, particularly for 16:0-, 18:0-, and 18:1-containing molecular species. These findings provide foundational data for future studies of factors shaping fish muscle PC composition.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究采用LC-MS脂质组学分析了8种鱼类骨骼肌的磷脂酰胆碱（PC）分子种，考察其与游泳生活方式及肌肉类型的关联。PC脂肪酸酰基组成和分子谱在物种间差异显著，主成分分析可将3种养殖鱼与5种野生海捕鱼区分开。野生种间比较提示，两种洄游性鲭属鱼类含18:0、20:4和22:6的PC分子种相对丰度总体高于两种底栖鱼类，且白肌与红肌的PC谱亦有差异。

papers.title: Abiotic Stressors and Infectious Disease in Aquaculture: Emerging Evidence for Environmental Contaminants as Hidden Disease Drivers
papers.authors: Hu, Yang; Gu, Bing‐nan; Shan, Li‐peng; Liu, Lei; Chen, Jiong
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Infectious disease in aquaculture is shaped by interactions among pathogens, hosts and the surrounding environment. Temperature, salinity and other physicochemical conditions are established modifiers of several aquatic diseases, whereas environmental contaminants have been studied predominantly for their direct toxic effects. Whether contaminant exposure also alters subsequent infection has received much less integrated attention. We critically evaluate evidence linking environmental contaminants with viral, bacterial and parasitic infections in aquatic animals, while using established physicochemical stressors as a reference framework. Direct challenge studies show that pesticides, persistent organic contaminants, microplastics, mycotoxins and other pollutants can alter pathogen replication, infection severity or infection‐associated mortality in specific host–pathogen systems. Several studies report altered infection outcomes after sublethal exposure despite limited or absent mortality, growth impairment or overt cytotoxicity before pathogen challenge. Pathogen challenge can therefore reveal functional effects of contaminant exposure that may be missed by conventional apical toxicity endpoints. However, the relationship is not uniform. Null, non‐monotonic and occasionally protective effects have also been reported, and most direct evidence remains confined to laboratory studies in fish and shrimp. Evidence for transmission, commercial production systems, molluscs and parasitic diseases is comparatively scarce. Environmental contaminants should therefore be regarded as context‐dependent modifiers of infectious‐disease risk rather than universal causes of disease outbreaks. Where contaminant‐associated susceptibility is demonstrated, disease control may need to address both the relevant contaminant exposure and the pathogen. This evidence supports exploring dual‐function interventions that restore or mitigate contaminant‐induced host dysfunction while directly inhibiting the pathogen.
papers.summary_cn: 本文系统评估了环境污染物作为水产养殖传染病隐性驱动因素的研究证据，以温度、盐度等理化胁迫因子为参照框架，梳理了污染物暴露对水生动物病毒、细菌及寄生虫感染的影响。直接攻毒实验表明，农药、持久性有机污染物、微塑料和霉菌毒素等可改变特定宿主-病原系统中的病原复制、感染严重程度或感染相关死亡率，且亚致死暴露在无明显毒性终点时仍可影响感染结局。然而该关系并不一致，无效应、非单调甚至保护性效应亦有报道，现有直接证据多局限于鱼虾的实验室研究，在传播途径、商业养殖系统、软体动物及寄生虫病方面证据相对匮乏。作者据此提出污染物应被视为传染病风险的语境依赖性调节因子而非暴发的普遍原因，并建议在证实污染物相关易感性的情形下探索兼顾宿主功能修复与病原直接抑制的双功能干预策略。

papers.title:
<scp>IUCN</scp>
                    Red List of Ecosystems Assessment of Tropical
                    <scp>Saccostrea</scp>
                    Oyster Reef Ecosystems in Queensland, Australia
papers.authors: Richardson, Marina A.; Traurig, Michael J.; Sievers, Michael; Nenadic, Nikolina; Waltham, Nathan J.; Gilby, Ben L.; McDougall, Carmel; Gillies, Chris L.; Connolly, Rod. M.
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Tropical oyster reefs are ecologically important ecosystems that support significant ecosystem services across coastal seascapes. Yet their current distribution and conservation needs remain poorly understood, limiting the effectiveness of management. In tropical Queensland, Australia, historical oyster reef declines and current threats have not been evaluated within a standardised risk‐assessment framework. Here, we apply the IUCN Red List of Ecosystems (RLE) criteria to assess the conservation status of tropical eastern Australian Saccostrea (TEAS) reef ecosystems. We synthesised historical records, contemporary satellite imagery and field surveys to delineate TEAS reef ecosystem characteristics, define functional and collapsed states and quantify changes in distribution. Our analysis reveals a reduction in reef ecosystem occurrences since 1750, restricted contemporary distributions, pervasive environmental degradation driven by increased catchment modification and sediment loads and identifies ongoing climate change and declining water quality as continuing and persistent risks to their conservation. We conclude that TEAS reef ecosystems are Vulnerable to extinction under three of five criteria (A: reduction in geographic distribution, B: restricted geographic range and C: environmental degradation). Criterion D (disruption of biotic processes and interactions) and Criterion E (quantitative risk analysis) were Data Deficient and not assessed. Formal recognition of TEAS reefs within state and federal conservation frameworks, alongside integrated catchment management, climate‐adaptive restoration approaches and improved species‐level taxonomic resolution, is essential for safeguarding these ecosystems. This assessment establishes the first baseline conservation evaluation for tropical oyster reefs in the world and provides a foundation for future regional and international assessments.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究首次将IUCN Red List of Ecosystems (RLE) 标准应用于澳大利亚昆士兰热带Saccostrea牡蛎礁生态系统，综合历史记录、卫星影像和野外调查界定其生态系统特征、功能状态与崩溃状态，并量化分布变化。结果显示自1750年以来牡蛎礁生态系统发生范围缩减、现代分布受限，流域改造与泥沙负荷导致普遍环境退化，气候变化和水质下降构成持续风险。评估判定该生态系统在五项标准中的三项（A地理分布缩减、B地理范围受限、C环境退化）下属于Vulnerable，D和E标准因数据缺乏未予评估。研究呼吁将该礁体纳入州与联邦保护框架，并推进流域综合管理、气候适应性修复及物种级分类厘定。

papers.title: Governing Across Scales: A Multi-Level, Participatory Governance Framework for Recreational Fisheries Sustainability in Southern Chile
papers.authors: Figueroa Hernández, David Alejandro; Muñoz-Vera, Francisco Javier; Jerez Briones, Jorge; Aguayo Arias, Carlos; Escalona Ulloa, Miguel; Molina Lopez, Sebastian Alonso; Aguayo Arias, Miguel Ángel
papers.abstract: Environmental governance in socio-ecological systems requires coordination among actors and institutions operating across different territorial and administrative scales. This study develops a multi-level environmental governance framework for recreational fisheries in the Toltén River Basin, southern Chile. A mixed-methods case study combined a socioeconomic survey of 188 stakeholders, semi-structured interviews with public-sector representatives, and participatory workshops conducted across the basin. Quantitative and qualitative evidence were integrated to identify governance challenges, territorial priorities, stakeholder roles, and opportunities for institutional coordination. The results identified resource-use pressures alongside institutional fragmentation, limited inter-municipal coordination, weak organisational capacity, and the limited availability of permanent mechanisms for collective action. Participatory mapping identified 61 priority areas for recreational fisheries and 74 conflict hotspots, highlighting the spatial extent of these challenges beyond municipal boundaries. Based on these findings, a governance framework was structured around municipal, river basin, and regional scales, linking local priorities with basin-scale coordination and regional planning. The framework builds on existing municipal and regional coordination mechanisms, while proposing basin-level coordination as a subsequent stage to strengthen cross-municipal articulation. The study illustrates how participatory processes can inform the development of place-based, multi-level governance arrangements for complex river basin systems and provides a case-based contribution to the study of recreational fisheries governance in territorially fragmented socio-ecological contexts.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究旨在为智利南部Toltén河流域的休闲渔业构建多层级环境治理框架。采用混合方法，结合188名利益相关者的社会经济调查、公共部门代表半结构化访谈及全流域参与式研讨会，识别治理挑战、地域优先事项与制度协调机会。结果揭示资源利用压力与制度碎片化并存，市际协调有限、组织能力薄弱且缺乏集体行动的常设机制；参与式制图识别出61个休闲渔业优先区和74个冲突热点，显示问题跨越市政边界。据此提出涵盖市政、流域和区域三个尺度的治理框架，以流域级协调作为强化跨市衔接的后续阶段。

papers.title: Decarbonizing Turkish Black Sea Commercial Fisheries Requires Pairing Industrial Engine-Power Limits with Capacity Reduction
papers.authors: Tunca, Sezgin
papers.journal: Turkish Journal of Maritime and Marine Sciences
papers.abstract: Commercial marine fisheries face growing pressure to cut carbon emissions while struggling with fleet overcapacity and volatile fuel prices. This study examines the Turkish Black Sea fleet (6584 vessels across 34 ports) by combining vessel registry records, long-run catch and cost accounts, hull-resistance estimates, port-level spatial patterns, fleet efficiency comparisons, and policy simulations. Registry data show that installed engine power is heavily concentrated in industrial purse seiners and trawlers, with nearly half of trawlers and one-fifth of purse seiners exceeding gear-specific power-to-tonnage reference ranges. Theoretical resistance estimates indicate that wave-making drag accounts for most hull resistance during free-running transit (58-79%) but becomes negligible during low-speed towing and net setting. Across the coast, vessel engine intensity clusters regionally, whereas total installed power is concentrated in major fishing ports. Financial accounts for 2023 show that fuel absorbs roughly one-fifth of gross revenue, leaving a 29.5% net margin after capital costs and exposing operators to sharp margin compression when diesel prices rise, while efficiency comparisons point to moderate room for emission reductions across regional fleet segments. Against a realistic operational baseline of 366.98 kt CO2 yr-1 (784.92 kt yr-1 at theoretical full capacity), a hypothetical policy combining a 441 kW active-gear engine-power limit with the retirement of vessels over 35 years old cuts projected emissions by 29.3% (107.55 kt CO2 yr-1, or 166.95 kt against the upper bound). Even so, retiring older vessels on its own barely shifts surviving-fleet profitability unless lower fleet crowding is assumed to improve catch rates. Long-run multi-basin records further show that broader catch diversity is associated with steadier revenues in smaller fleets, a relationship that weakens as vessel numbers grow.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究基于船舶登记、渔获与成本核算、船体阻力估算及政策模拟，分析土耳其黑海商业船队（6584艘、34个港口）的碳排放与产能问题。结果显示，工业围网船和拖网船的装机功率高度集中，约半数拖网船和五分之一围网船超出特定渔具的功率-吨位参考范围；2023年燃油约占总收入五分之一，净利率29.5%。模拟表明，将主动渔具功率限制在441 kW并淘汰35年以上船龄船舶，可在实际运营基线366.98 kt CO2 yr-1上减排29.3%，但仅淘汰老旧船舶对存活船队盈利能力影响有限，除非船队拥挤度下降提升捕捞率。

papers.title: Scientometric Analysis of Fisheries Cooperatives’ Research Landscape in India vis-a-vis the World (1941-2023)
papers.authors: Samatha, Beemalla; Argade, Shivaji; Ananthan, P. S.; Debnath, Sourav
papers.journal: Journal of Scientific Research and Reports
papers.abstract: Fisheries cooperatives are considered one of the most effective means of developing the fisheries sector and improving the living standards of poor fishermen. The current study maps research output on fisheries cooperatives during 1941–2023 using data retrieved from the Dimensions AI database, Google Scholar, and ResearchGate. A total of 310 publications were used for this investigation to evaluate the scientific productivity in the selected subject area. Thematic analysis was also used to review the global research landscape in fisheries cooperatives. Global publication shares, rankings and developments in research and bibliometric indices such as overall citations and average citation per paper were also analysed. In continent-specific publications, Asia ranked first (73.87%); in country-specific publications, Japan ranked first (26.13%), and within India, Kerala (20.59%) has the highest number. The journal Marine Policy (4.19%) carried the highest number of research papers. However, important gaps remain, particularly the under-representation of geographical regions. The thematic analysis revealed that studies predominantly focused on marine societies. Among all the studies, the principal areas of focus included the role of cooperatives and challenges (30.38%), socio-economic and financial analysis (29.75%), governance and management (26.58%), sustainability and conservation (7.59%), gender/women empowerment (3.48%), and technology integration (2.22%). Overall, this study highlights the importance of growth dynamics in fisheries cooperatives and identifies future research areas. These findings provide valuable insights for enhancing research efforts in this area, which may help improve the performance of these societies and support their development.
papers.summary_cn: 该研究基于Dimensions AI、Google Scholar和ResearchGate数据，对1941–2023年全球渔业合作社研究文献（310篇）进行科学计量分析，考察科研产出、引用指标与主题分布。结果显示亚洲占全球发文量73.87%居首，日本（26.13%）与印度喀拉拉邦（20.59%）分别为国家和区域最高，Marine Policy（4.19%）为载文最多期刊。主题分析表明研究集中于合作社作用与挑战（30.38%）、社会经济与财务分析（29.75%）、治理与管理（26.58%），而可持续性与保护、性别赋权和技术整合研究明显不足，地理区域代表性亦存在缺口。
